raw.description:
Prominence is looking for the best Technical Project managers in healthcare to join our Analytics team.

Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare technology strategy and implementation firm, focused on helping the nation’s leading healthcare organizations to do more with their data. Founded by former Epic managers, we understand the technology landscape in healthcare and provide IT staffing, advisory services, and analytics solutions to create robust data ecosystems that support clinical workflows, automate operational processes, and expedite research. Whether it’s guiding a technology implementation, establishing governance principles, or developing leading edge analytics, we help our customers make sense out of the mountain of data at their fingertips in order to deliver higher quality care at a lower cost.

Ranked as a best place to work over 27 times (and counting!), Prominence’s culture provides consultants with a supportive environment that allows you to innovate and grow your career in healthcare IT. Additional information is available on our website.

Your Role

Our consultants guide our customers through complex technology requirements to summit the challenge at hand. You will need to be able to create order out of chaos, and compile ambiguous information into tactical action plans.

Our ideal team members are humble, smart, and driven to ensure our customer’s success. This includes a passion to deliver high-quality results, while teaching our counterparts how to fish and grow the skills needed to support and expand upon the deliverables of our projects.

If this sounds like you, and you meet the requirements below, we encourage you to apply. If you know of someone else how would be a great fit, let us know.

Requirements

Our Project Managers are problem solvers, ensuring that our healthcare clients realize the benefits of agile analytics and governance-based processes to improve patient outcomes.

Responsibilities include managing project scope, timeline, budget, resources, executive and stakeholder communication, as well as customer satisfaction. Additional growth opportunities, available based on performance, include executive relations and implementation management.

This position is a full-time, salaried position with benefits. There is no relocation required. Candidates are required to have a suitable home office to operate from.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Leadership experience in previous roles such as director, supervisor, manager, or team lead
  • Ability to learn new software paradigms and quickly apply them to customer and internal projects
  • Ability to apply logic-based approaches to new challenges
  • Experience managing customer expectations and relationships for complex, technical projects
  • Experience in successfully balancing work across multiple customers and teams simultaneously
  • Strong communication skills; ability to constructively solve problems and conduct project team, stakeholder, and executive status meetings remotely
  • Strong management skills; ability to document project decisions, manage project scope, and escalate project concerns appropriately

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with healthcare analytics, EMR implementation, or EMR support
  • Experience with Tableau preferred; other BI software (QlikView, Qlik Sense, Power BI) are also considered

Success Criteria

Successful team members at Prominence display the following:

  • High degree of professionalism; treats others with respect, keeps commitments, builds trust within a team, works with integrity, and upholds organizational values.
  • Highly organized; able to manage multi-faceted workstreams.
  • Self-motivated; able to maintain schedule, meet deadlines, and monitor your personal work product.
  • Highly adaptable; able to acclimate quickly to new project assignments and work environments.
  • Creative; not paralyzed by problems and able to work collaboratively to find novel solutions.
  • Clear communication skills; ability to clearly convey messaging that resonates with your audience, in clear and concise written and verbal communications.
  • Can smell smoke and anticipate issues before they arise, ability to escalate effectively.
  • Passion to mentor and guide others.

Benefits

Prominence is dedicated to hiring the best and brightest minds in healthcare and maintaining a culture that rewards our employees for following their passion. We are excited to offer the following benefits for this position:

  • Competitive Salaried and Hybrid Compensation Plans
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, HSAs, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Dependent & Health Savings Accounts
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation/Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Training & Development Fund
  • Work From Home
  • Charitable Giving to Causes You Believe In

Employment Eligibility

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

The world’s most talented professionals come from every background. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, veteran or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, Prominence will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

Partnership Eligibility

Our partnerships are extremely important to us. This online application is not intended for anyone who is currently under a non-compete agreement or has an arrangement that precludes employment at Prominence. We appreciate your help in respecting our partners.

Interested in learning more? Apply below to connect with our Talent team about immediate openings and future consulting projects.

Network Leadership & Escalation:
Serves as the highest on shift escalation point for complex network issues, including routing, switching, firewalling, VPN, and connectivity failures. Provides expert level troubleshooting and root cause analysis, building on Level 2 responsibilities such as: “Diagnoses and resolves complex issues across host environments and connectivity layers.”; Ensures network credential separation from server-focused staff.

Operational Oversight:
Oversees daily NOC operations for network monitoring, alert triage and proactive remediation. Ensures consistent execution of monitoring tasks derived from Level 2 duties like: "Performs daily monitoring and initiates proactive measures to ensure system functionality and load balance." Ensures 24x7 coverage, shift handoff quality and operational continuity.

Incident & Problem Management:
Owns major network incidents from detection through resolution. Leads post-incident reviews and drives long-term network remediation. Coordinates with Windows/Linux teams for cross-domain issues while maintaining credential boundaries. Cyber Backup / Cyber Vault Support: Provides network expertise for the Cyber Backup environment in December. Ensures the NOC (not the customer's network team) supports this service. Trains Level 2 network staff on Cyber Backup network requirements.

Documentation, Compliance & Process Improvement:
Oversees network runbooks, SOPs, diagrams and configuration documentation. Ensures accurate configuration data, consistent with Level 2 expectations such as: "Updates system records and maintains accurate configuration data." Identifies operationaaal gaps and implements improvements across tools and workflows.

Team Leadership & Knowledge Transfer:
Provides ily guidel 2 and Level 1 staff. Validates readiness and ensures consistent execution of network procedures. Reviews and approves runbooks and how-to guides created by Level 2 network staff.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • BA/BS degree and 4–6 years of relevant experience OR equivalent combination.
    • Deep expertise in network engineering (routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, load balancing).
    • Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams in a 24×7 operational environment.
    • Strong background in incident management and operational reporting.
    • U.S. Citizenship and U.S. residency required.
    • Ability to work rotating shifts and support mission critical operations.

Description

Join Us at TailorMed – Transforming Healthcare Affordability

Awarded Best in Class in Health Equity 2025

At TailorMed, we’re on a mission to eliminate barriers across the entire medication journey—from affordability to access and adherence. As a pioneering force in healthcare, we’re building a new category that transforms how patients, providers, pharmacies, life sciences, and payers collaborate to ensure every patient receives the treatment they need without delay.

TailorMed is the medication success platform removing every barrier across the patient journey, from access and affordability through adherence and ongoing care. Through a connected network spanning 945+ hospitals, 4,700+ clinics, 3,100+ pharmacies, 100+ life sciences programs, and 6,000+ support programs, TailorMed has supported over 75 million patients and secured more than $7.4 billion in financial assistance since 2020. TailorMed's platform connects patients, providers, pharmacies, and life sciences companies through one coordinated network designed to reach every patient at every step of their medication journey.

Learn more at

About the Role:

The Customer Success Manager serves as an advocate and the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts, ensuring customers are fully engaged and deriving maximum value from our solutions. In this role, you’ll guide clients through the entire customer journey—from onboarding to ongoing support to renewal—not only providing exceptional service, but identifying opportunities to expand and provide even greater ROI for our clients.

You’ll be responsible for driving the adoption of our software, helping to resolve issues, and proactively promoting new features and best practices to maximize customer success and usage of our solution. As the day-to-day contact for your accounts, you will build strong relationships and ensure that each customer is receiving maximum value from our solution. Additionally, you’ll collaborate closely with our Product and R&D teams, acting as the voice of the customer to provide feedback and drive continuous improvement.

This hands-on role is perfect for someone passionate about commercially focused customer success and eager to make a direct impact by ensuring customers are satisfied and successful with TailorMed’s solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Become a trusted advisor to customers, key stakeholders, and executive sponsors
  • Collaborate with TailorMed’s commercial team to identify growth opportunities, supporting account renewals and expansions
  • Define, measure, and communicate ROI for our customers, throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Lead QBRs and EBRs on a regular basis, and accurately reflect to customers their means to success while calling out any red flags
  • Handle commercial items such as renewals, churn prevention, and expansion opportunities
  • Be the product expert, advising customers on use cases and product functionality
  • Simplify and project manage any customer issues to ensure clarity and progress towards both short- and long-term solutions
  • Coordinate various cross-functional teams at TailorMed and throughout the ecosystem, to ensure customers get what they need to connect their applications, data, and devices, and receive an excellent and consistent customer experience, all the time, every time
  • Represent the voice of the customer to our Product and R&D teams to help them innovate new features and improvements
  • Keep current on new product releases and continuously educate your customers on how new features can benefit their business

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of customer success or account management experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment; experience in the healthcare space is ideal
  • Experience with transformation or program management at an organization-wide level
  • Demonstrated ability to help customers use products effectively and increase their satisfaction, and a passion for providing excellent customer service
  • Comfortable communicating and managing relationships with different levels of stakeholders
  • Experience successfully navigating renewals with complex customers
  • Successfully identifying expansion opportunities that led to account growth
  • Analytical, strategic thinker and a proactive problem solver
  • Polished verbal and written communication skills
  • Technical understanding to credibly partner with IT organizations
  • Track record of performance and a growth mindset
  • Ability to influence action within and outside of your own team
  • Ability to drive change within our customers’ and internal organizations
  • Deliver on unique initiatives or critical business issues within complex environments
  • Ability to travel approximately 20% of the time

What We Offer

raw.description:
The client is an Australian finance-broking business based in Queensland.

The business provides tailored finance solutions across home loans, refinancing, investment lending, commercial finance, business loans, equipment finance and personal lending.

With access to a broad panel of banks and lenders, they works closely with clients to understand their circumstances and identify suitable finance solutions. The team is committed to providing a personalised, efficient and well-organised experience from the initial enquiry through to application and settlement.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised Mortgage Broking Support Specialist to assist with loan administration, client follow-ups, compliance documentation, serviceability calculations and application preparation.

The successful candidate will help maintain accurate and complete client files in Mercury, follow up on outstanding documents and assessment requirements, prepare compliance and Best Interests Duty notes, and support the submission of applications through ApplyOnline.

This role requires strong attention to detail, practical knowledge of the Australian mortgage-broking process and the ability to manage multiple client files at different stages.

The key objective is to provide dependable back-office support so brokers can spend more time advising clients while ensuring applications remain accurate, compliant and moving forward.

Key Responsibilities

Client Communication & Follow-Ups

  • Send professional reminders to clients regarding outstanding information, documents and upcoming requirements.
  • Follow up on requested supporting documents, including payslips, bank statements, identification and other application evidence.
  • Follow up on additional documents or information requested during lender assessment.
  • Check received documents against the outstanding requirements list and update the client file accordingly.
  • Keep clients informed of the next administrative steps in the application process.
  • Escalate delays, incomplete information or client concerns to the broker promptly.
  • Maintain clear and professional written communication throughout the client journey.

Compliance & Best Interests Duty Notes

  • Assist with preparing accurate compliance and Best Interests Duty notes based on information and instructions supplied by the broker.
  • Ensure relevant research, discussions, product comparisons and supporting information are clearly documented.
  • Check that required compliance documents and disclosures are present in each client file.
  • Maintain complete and orderly records to support internal reviews and potential audits.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent information and refer it to the broker for clarification.
  • Ensure all compliance work is completed in accordance with the business’s procedures and remains subject to broker review and approval.

Serviceability & Lender Research Support

  • Accurately enter client income, expenses, liabilities, assets and proposed lending details into lender or aggregator serviceability calculators.
  • Review the entered information carefully to ensure calculations reflect the client’s supplied documents.
  • Research lender policies and servicing requirements to identify options that may suit the client’s circumstances.
  • Compare servicing outcomes across relevant lenders and clearly document the results for broker review.
  • Check key policy considerations, including income treatment, employment type, liabilities, loan-to-value ratio and supporting-document requirements.
  • Flag policy exceptions, servicing concerns or unclear information to the broker.
  • Ensure that all lender recommendations and final credit advice remain the responsibility of the authorised mortgage broker.

Mercury CRM & File Management

  • Create, maintain and update client records in Mercury.
  • Ensure personal details, employment information, financial information, application data and contact records are current and accurate.
  • Tidy and organise Mercury files so documents, notes, tasks and application information are complete and easy to locate.

With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

AllCloud is seeking an Associate Account Executive to support the sale of professional services associated with the Salesforce platform. In this role, you will generate new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, and you will partner closely with senior Account Executives to help develop and grow existing client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career sales professional to build a foundation in consultative, solution-based selling within a fast-growing cloud services practice, while receiving direct mentorship from experienced enterprise sellers.

Account Management & Growth:

  • Strategic Account Support: Support the growth of key strategic accounts — building relationships with business stakeholders, contributing to long-term Salesforce roadmaps, and helping identify Statements of Work for professional services and managed services engagements.

  • Quarterly Business Reviews: Prepare and, over time, independently deliver QBRs — owning the agenda, deck, pre-read, and follow-up.
  • Executive Alignment Calls: Help set up and run recurring executive alignment calls, working closely with Project Managers and delivery leadership.

Sales Development & Pipeline:

  • Prospecting & Lead Generation: Generate net-new pipeline through LinkedIn social selling, Salesforce channel introductions, industry events, and targeted outreach.

Channel, Delivery & Thought Leadership

Experience

  • 1-3 years of entry-level professional experience, internships, or a background in basic sales, client support, or lead generation.

Core Skills

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to pitch services and engage with clients.

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

deine aufgaben

Worum es geht
Der 1st Level nimmt die Tickets an und sortiert vor. Ab da bist du dran. Webstack-Fehler eingrenzen, Mailprobleme debuggen, Konfigurationen auf Systemebene korrigieren. Wenn ein Thema dreimal vorkommt, schreibst du ein Runbook.

Was du bei uns machst

  • L2-Tickets bearbeiten: Webstack-Fehler eingrenzen, Mail-Zustellbarkeit debuggen, Konfigurationsprobleme in Hosting-Umgebungen lösen, Backup-/Restore-Fälle auf Systemebene durchführen
  • Fehler analysieren und beheben: Ursachen eingrenzen, kontrolliert lösen, so dokumentieren, dass Kollegen den Fall jederzeit übernehmen könnten
  • Standard-Changes durchführen: Wiederherstellungen, Konfigurationsanpassungen, Monitoring-Follow-ups im Managed-Betrieb
  • Eskalationen vorbereiten: Komplexere Fälle mit Logs, Tests und klarer Abgrenzung an Spezialisten übergeben
  • Support weiterentwickeln: Wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder in Runbooks und Checklisten überführen

dein profil

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Linux-Systembetrieb: Shell-sicher, Dienste und Logs verstehen, Konfigurationen kontrolliert ändern
  • Web- und Mail-Stack: Erfahrung mit Webservern (z. B. NGINX, Apache), PHP-Runtimes (z. B. PHP-FPM), Datenbanken (z. B. MySQL, MariaDB) und gängigen Mailserver-Setups
  • Hosting-Grundlagen: DNS, SSL/TLS, Domainverwaltung, typische Zugriffs- und Recovery-Wege (Rescue, Konsole, IPMI) sowie ein Verständnis für die Unterschiede zwischen Shared Hosting, VPS und Dedicated
  • Strukturierte Fehleranalyse: Du gehst Probleme systematisch an und dokumentierst, was du getan hast
  • Kommunikation: Gutes Deutsch, technisches Englisch. Klar und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden und im Team. Wer etwas nicht weiß, fragt nach.
Plus, wenn du es hast: Hosting-Panels (z. B. Plesk) · Virtualisierung (z. B. KVM, Proxmox) · Monitoring (z. B. checkmk, Grafana) · Ansible/Shell-Skripting · Windows/AD-Basics

warum wir?

Was du dafür bekommst

  • 100 % remote, freie Hardware-Wahl. Linux-Setups ausdrücklich willkommen
  • Home-Office-Zuschuss
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Ob Richtung Systemadministration, Netzwerk oder Entwicklung. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich in die Richtung zu bewegen, die zu dir passt.
  • Ein kleines Team, in dem man sich kennt und nicht hinter Ticketnummern verschwindet
So läuft die Bewerbung
Bewerbung unter Beantwortung einiger Fragen → Videocall zum Kennenlernen (ca. 30 Minuten) → Videocall mit Interview und Work Samples (ca. 90 Minuten) → Entscheidung.

The role will ensure data is responsibly sourced, aligned to business needs, and positioned for long-term value through effective onboarding, governance, and supplier management.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and acquisition of external data sources that support business strategy and product priorities for phone intelligence and mobile identity solutions.

  • Identify new market opportunities and data partnerships that strengthen product differentiation and long-term growth

  • Build and manage relationships with data suppliers, serving as the primary point of coordination throughout the acquisition lifecycle

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, analytics, legal, compliance, finance, and technology teams to assess opportunities and advance initiatives

  • Drive supplier due diligence, data evaluations, and onboarding activities to ensure new data assets meet business, operational, and compliance requirements

  • Negotiate commercial terms and support contract development in partnership with legal and business stakeholders

  • Oversee the successful transition of new data assets from evaluation through implementation and operational handoff

  • Monitor supplier performance, manage ongoing governance activities, and help address issues, renewals, and contract-related decisions

  • Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and status updates to support prioritization and executive decision-making

  • Ensure all acquisition activities align with internal policies, risk standards, and regulatory requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business or Risk Management, preferred

  • Minimum 9 years related work experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in mobile identity and phone intelligence at a global scale, including practical knowledge of data sources, market dynamics, and use cases across regions.

  • Established relationships and experience working with mobile network operators, telco carriers, and related partner ecosystems to support data sourcing, and commercialization of phone intelligence solutions.

  • Understanding of regulatory requirements across multiple countries and industries governing the use of phone numbers and phone intelligence data.

  • Experienced in contract negotiations, including negotiating commercial and contractual terms with external partners and suppliers.

  • Experience managing multiple external data and vendor relationships of varying size and scale, including accountability for the P&L associated with those relationships.

  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working in a dynamic environment with minimal supervision.

  • Strong research, financial analysis, business analyst/support skills

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to clearly engage stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, issues, and deadlines concurrently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart’s retail media platform, Carrot Ads, is scaling fast — and the strategic retail partners who power it need more than a point of contact. They need a trusted advisor who knows their business, knows ours, and can translate that into advertising performance that grows over time. Without this role, we risk leaving adoption on the table, missing signals from partners who could shape our product roadmap, and letting high-potential relationships stagnate. We’re hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of enterprise retail partners end-to-end — from onboarding through growth — and make Carrot Ads an indispensable part of how they compete. This role sits at the center of Instacart’s retail media expansion, with a direct line of sight to partner revenue, product adoption, and the future of how we go to market.

What you’ll cook up in your first year

  • A portfolio of strategic enterprise retail partners is measurably healthier — adoption is up, revenue is growing, and partners are pointing to Carrot Ads as a competitive advantage.
  • New retail partners are onboarded smoothly and confidently — trained on campaign tooling, demand sourcing, reporting, and invoicing — so they hit the ground running and don’t stall out early.
  • Partners are adopting expanded placements and new product capabilities because you’ve made the incremental revenue case clearly — and Product teams have better data to work with because of the feedback loops you’ve built.
  • The account management practice is sharper than when you arrived — playbooks are tighter, QBR formats are more compelling, and the team has better tools for tracking partner KPIs and scaling what works.
  • Cross-functional partners — from Business Development to Finance to Ads Quality — know who to call when something involves the retail partner book, because you’ve become the connective tissue across teams.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years in Account Management or a related field, with experience in ad tech, publishers, or retail media.
  • Proven experience supporting enterprise solutions in the advertising space, including managing complex partner relationships end-to-end.
  • Strong technical acumen — able to understand and explain complex product capabilities to partners who may not be technical.
  • Proficient in data analysis with the ability to derive actionable insights and make strategic recommendations from partner KPI data.
  • Comfortable navigating billing, invoicing, and revenue reconciliation workflows in partnership with Finance.
  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to distill complex concepts for varied audiences — from technical teams to executive stakeholders.
  • Proven project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple partner relationships and internal workstreams simultaneously.
  • Experienced in cross-functional collaboration and executive-level presentations.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Specific industry experience in advertising, grocery, and/or e-commerce.
  • Proven track record of building growth narratives and revenue-driving strategies for enterprise retail partners.
  • Experience in collaborative management of enterprise accounts alongside sales teams in a partner-facing environment.

About Oshkosh Defense, an Oshkosh company

Oshkosh Defense stands behind those who dedicate their lives to protecting others. As an industry-leading tactical vehicle manufacturer, every day we strive to meet or exceed our customers' ever-changing needs with next generation defense technologies and advanced systems. We operate with unparalleled commitment to those who depend on our products and services worldwide to perform their missions.

As a Senior IT Technical Analyst (JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC) you will administer, configure, and support JD Edwards Enterprise One CNC environments including system architecture, security, performance tuning, and lifecycle management. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, stable, and repeatable ERP infrastructure solutions that support business and stakeholder requirements.

YOUR IMPACT:

These duties are not meant to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned:

  • Serve as a role model in customer and IT colleague communication, delivering JD Edwards CNC solutions in a timely and effective manner.
  • Utilize ITIL methodology and ticketing systems to manage incidents, changes, problems, and service requests within JDE environments.
  • Install, configure, and maintain JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments including ESUs, ASUs, Tools Releases, and application upgrades.
  • Manage and support CNC activities including package builds, deployments, security administration, and environment refreshes.
  • Partner with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to support business requirements through stable and optimized JDE environments.
  • Perform system monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning across JDE architecture including web, enterprise, and database servers.
  • Maintain and support integrations including Application Interface Server (AIS), Orchestrator Studio, Business Services (BSSV), and interoperability frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, standards, and best practices for JDE CNC processes.
  • Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies are in place and tested.
  • Support and maintain JDE security, user roles, and environment controls.
  • Lead CNC-related projects including upgrades, migrations, cloud initiatives, and environment redesigns.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, database, and network teams to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
  • Serve as subject matter expert for JD Edwards CNC, supporting escalations and complex issue resolution.
  • Mentor team members on JDE CNC best practices and operational excellence.
  • Partner with vendors and Oracle support for issue resolution, patching strategies, and system improvements.
  • Participate in capacity planning and long-term strategic roadmap for JDE environments.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Five (5) or more years of experience in the field or in a related area.
  • Experience with JDE architecture, package management, security, server management, troubleshooting, performance tuning, integrations, and system lifecycle management.
  • Strong skills in documentation, communication, stakeholder alignment, problem solving, and cross-team collaboration.

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelors degree in Information Technology or related field
  • Strong time-management and prioritization skills, able to multi-task and prioritize competing requirements and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where requirements are constantly changing.
  • Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Working Hours: Our team operates 24/7 due to the nature of the digital technology work we support. In this role, you must cover night, weekend, and holiday shifts when the business requires it.
  • PhysicalDemands: Frequent Sitting, Hearing, Talking, Visual, Typing, Manual Dexterity; Seldom Standing, Walking/Running, Reaching, Driving, Bending/Kneeling, Fine Dexterity, Upper Extremity Repetitive Motion, and Lifting/Carrying and Pushing/Pulling up to 40lbs.

Pay Range:

$92,600.00 - $154,400.00

The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success.

raw.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Trabajas en un servicio de salud o preparas oposiciones de Sanidad? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza en el SAS, SERMAS y más.

📚 Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores

Sin titulación sanitaria específica

  • Celador/a

  • Auxiliar Administrativo/a (Grupo Auxiliar de la Función Administrativa)

  • Administrativo/a (Grupo Administrativo de la Función Administrativa)

Formación Profesional sanitaria

  • Técnico/a en Cuidados Auxiliares de Enfermería (TCAE)

  • Técnico/a Superior en Laboratorio Clínico y Biomédico

Titulación universitaria

  • Enfermero/a

  • Fisioterapeuta

🏥 Buscamos preparadores que conozcan los servicios de salud por dentro

Cada comunidad autónoma convoca sus plazas a través de su propio servicio de salud, con su temario específico, sus bases y su baremo. Por eso buscamos preparadores que conozcan a fondo uno o varios servicios de salud: SAS, SERMAS, SACYL, SESCAM, SERGAS, SESPA, SALUD, SMS, SES, ICS, Osakidetza, IB-SALUT, SNS-O, SERIS, Servicio Canario de Salud, Servicio Cántabro de Salud o Conselleria de Sanidad (GVA).

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Profesionales con plaza en un servicio de salud (personal estatutario o funcionario), en activo o en excedencia, en la categoría que quieren preparar.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones.

  • Personas que conozcan el proceso de primera mano: temario común y específico, tipo de examen, baremo de méritos y bolsas de empleo.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil, categoría y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

  • Temario común y específico adaptado a cada servicio de salud, con su actualización normativa.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real de cada convocatoria.

  • Supuestos prácticos, en las categorías que los incluyen.

  • Orientación sobre baremo, méritos y bolsas de empleo.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si trabajas en un servicio de salud, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir, compatibles con turnos
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia y qué categoría y servicio de salud conoces.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos sobre un contenido de tu oposición, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza en Sanidad y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
CrowdStrike is seeking a Corporate Account Manager to ensure that our regional customers are successful and thriving with our next generation endpoint technology. This is a full sales cycle role in which you will proactively advocate for the customers in corporate segment, while focusing on high levels of adoption to ensure customer satisfaction. You will balance discovering upsell and cross-sell opportunities while partnering with our renewals team to ensure timely renewals.

This position is open to candidates that are located remotely in Hyderabad.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients while collaborating with various internal stakeholders (Customer Success, Managed Services, etc.) to ensure the existing customer base in AP & Telangana is receiving the value they expect from their previous purchase

  • Manage the contract renewal cycle from scheduling initial meetings through negotiation, contract changes, and signature while ensuring customers renew at an escalated ARR rate.

  • Achieve a quota of new sales growth within the customer base in AP & Telangana.

  • Be a customer advocate, driving relationships with key customers and creating new champions.

  • Identify whitespace in accounts and create value-based presentations to promote upgrades and cross-sells.

  • Consult with our existing customers to recommend additional solutions from the CrowdStrike portfolio to increase ingestion.

  • Devise and execute account strategies and plans to maximize account growth.

  • Provide high touch customer service, including escalation and coordination of support issues as needed.

  • Deliver feedback to the Product Management team on new feature requests and product enhancements from your customer base.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience of full sales cycle experience in account management or net new logo capacity, selling to a technical audience such as engineers, IT, security, and other related fields.

  • Strong ability to run a discovery, manage full sales cycle, handle objections, implement a multi-faceted sales strategy such as working with partners, and close deals.

  • Light experience and/or understanding of sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Sandler

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding expectations in an individually focused, quota and/or metric carrying role.

  • Ability to successfully balance a wide variety of daily tasks and adjust priorities on the fly in a fast-paced environment over multiple engagements.

  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn new concepts quickly.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills demonstrated through email, conference calls, client visits and presentations, and internal meetings

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • High level of comfort handling client objections and negotiations.

Bonus Points:

  • Cyber Security industry experience

  • Security and/or SaaS Sales experience

  • Advanced experience and/or understanding of sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Sandler

About Aptus Data Labs

Aptus Data Labs is a global Data Engineering and AI consulting company helping enterprises modernize their data landscape, accelerate AI adoption, and build scalable digital and product capabilities. With deep expertise across AI, Generative AI, Data Engineering, Cloud, and industry platforms, we empower organizations in Pharmaceutical, Banking & Finance, Manufacturing & Supply Chain, Retail & CPG, and Technology (Software & Platform) to achieve measurable business outcomes and long-term competitive advantage.

Role Overview

In this role, you will lead strategic sales cycles, shape CXO conversations, drive GTM execution, and influence our global expansion. Key Responsibilities

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.


About the Role

We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) with oncology monitoring experience to join our team. As a CRA, you will manage clinical sites from identification through closeout, serving as the primary point of contact for site teams and helping ensure study quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and accurate clinical data.


You will conduct onsite monitoring activities, build and maintain productive site relationships, address site issues, and support enrollment and study delivery. Parexel provides world-class technology, training tailored to your experience, opportunities to work across therapeutic areas, and pathways for continued growth within clinical research.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct qualification visits (QV), site initiation visits (SIV), monitoring visits (MV), and termination visits (TV) at assigned clinical sites, and prepare timely visit and contact reports.
  • Manage site quality and delivery from site identification through closeout.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clinical sites, addressing questions and resolving issues to support successful study execution.
  • Oversee study integrity and build effective relationships with investigators and site staff.
  • Review trial performance at designated sites and help safeguard the rights, safety, and well-being of study participants in accordance with the protocol.
  • Develop patient recruitment strategies with clinical sites to support enrollment timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with approved standard operating procedures, study protocols and amendments, Good Clinical Practice, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate the quality and integrity of reported data, site performance, and investigational product accountability.
  • Monitor the completeness and quality of regulatory documentation and perform site document verification.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strong site relationship management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently with urgency and limited oversight.
  • A client-focused, flexible approach to assignments and continuous learning.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, evaluate changing scenarios, apply study protocols, and meet project timelines.
  • An ethical, patient-focused approach and strong attention to quality and detail.
  • Comfort collaborating within a matrixed team and communicating clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 18 months of direct onsite monitoring experience as a Clinical Research Associate.
  • Oncology clinical trial monitoring experience.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in biological science, pharmacy, or another health-related discipline.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice, applicable regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.
  • Experience using a Clinical Trial Management System, an Electronic Document Management System, and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, verbal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

We are looking for a Director, Product Management – Search & Match to shape and drive our core algorithm, ranking, discovery, and recommendation product strategies. Reporting to the VP of AI & Platform Products, you will act as a key product and business partner, translating complex data systems into high-impact executive narratives, commercial growth levers, and seamless marketplace experiences. This role requires an experienced leader who blends strong business sense with high-impact executive presentation skills to align senior stakeholders, optimize platform resource allocation, and lead cross-functional product teams.

Search & Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform’s two-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.

About this team

Our mission is to provide the best-in-class job search tools that drive the best outcomes for job seekers and provide long term value for our brand. This team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Design, and Finance to achieve business goals.

What you'll do

Shape and Drive Two-Sided Marketplace Strategy

  • Align Strategy to Business Impact: Define and own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Search & Match, directly linking algorithmic advancements to core business outcomes, enterprise customer value, and job seeker engagement.
  • Dual-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).
  • Resource & ROI Stewardship: Govern functional team capacity, compute/infrastructure investments, and feature prioritization—balancing trade-offs between performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Market & Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.

Executive Influence & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Executive Storytelling & Presentation: Translate complex search performance, algorithmic models, and marketplace dynamics into clear, compelling narratives and board-ready presentations for executive leadership.
  • Build Cross-Functional Coalitions: Drive strategic consensus across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Enterprise GTM, and Consumer Operations—ensuring alignment on roadmap sequencing and operational trade-offs.
  • Lead Through Change: Guide functional teams through strategic pivots, shifting organizational priorities, and technology evolutions with structured rationale and strong clarity.

Drive Operational Excellence & Execution

  • Orchestrate Execution at Scale: Lead cross-functional product squads across match scoring, candidate indexing, search relevance, and recommendation feeds to ensure predictable, high-velocity delivery.
  • Systems & Marketplace Metrics: Establish clear performance metrics to measure search precision, recall, candidate-to-job match relevance, search latency, and reciprocal marketplace liquidity.
  • Culture of Experimentation: Oversee rigorous A/B testing and experimentation protocols to continuously refine discovery algorithms for both candidate and recruiter touchpoints.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Mentorship & Talent Pipeline: Coach and develop Product Managers, instilling strong business sense, strategic thinking, user empathy, and executive communication skills.
  • Evolve Product Rituals: Establish operational frameworks, governance rituals, and decision-making standards that foster velocity and transparency across teams.

What you'll need

  • 8–10+ years of experience in product management, with significant experience leading two-sided marketplaces, search engines, recommendation systems, or match platforms.
  • Proven Executive Presence: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities—able to influence executive leadership, translate complex technical topics into business impact, and drive organizational consensus.
  • Strong Business Sense: Deep commercial intuition with the ability to connect algorithmic performance (relevance, precision, candidate conversion) directly to platform health and client retention.
  • Two-Sided Marketplace Expertise: Proven track record of balancing dual stakeholder needs—solving for both B2C consumer discovery and B2B enterprise/recruiter search workflows.
  • Strategic & Resource Allocation Mastery: Experience shaping functional product strategies, managing engineering trade-offs, and maximizing investment ROI without direct P&L management.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Skilled at building trust and alignment across matrixed organizations, including Data Science, Machine Learning, UX, and Commercial teams.
  • People Management Experience: Demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and leading product managers to drive team growth and operational excellence.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical, quantitative, or business field (or equivalent practical experience).

What's good to have

  • Direct experience presenting strategic roadmaps and performance insights to C-suite executives and board members.
  • Background in recruitment technology, two-sided talent marketplaces, resume indexing systems, or professional networking platforms.
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML search paradigms, Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic matching, or vector search technologies.
  • Experience scaling product rituals and decision frameworks within high-growth software organizations.

You will oversee a multi-faceted account structure—including Branded, Non-Branded, Performance Max (PMax), and Demand Generation campaigns—leveraging advanced tROAS bidding strategies to maximize revenue and return on ad spend.

What are your responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Account Ownership: Strategy, buildout, optimization, and daily management of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts targeting high-volume revenue growth.
  • Bidding Strategy & Budget Allocation: Manage and fine-tune automated bidding strategies (specifically tROAS and Maximize Conversion Value), continuously balancing spend between high-intent search, PMax, and Demand Gen channels.
  • Campaign Execution & Optimization:
    • Structure and refine Branded and Non-Branded search campaigns for high relevance, strong quality scores, and efficiency.
    • Optimize Performance Max (PMax) campaigns using strategic asset groups, audience signals, negative keyword lists, and placement exclusions.
    • Scale Demand Generation campaigns to capture upper/mid-funnel demand through engaging visual and video assets across YouTube, Discover, and Gmail.
  • Testing & Experimentation: Design and execute structured A/B tests for ad copy, landing pages, creative assets, audience targeting, and bidding targets.
  • Data & Attribution Integrity: Collaborate with data/analytics teams to ensure accurate conversion value modeling, offline conversion tracking (OCT), first-party data integration, and attribution accuracy.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Creative, Copywriting, and Landing Page teams to supply high-performing assets for Demand Gen and PMax campaigns.
  • Reporting & Insights: Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports highlighting key metrics (Spend, Revenue, ROAS, CPA, Conversion Value) and actionable insights to senior leadership.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Experience: 4–6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience managing large-scale Paid Search (Google Ads & Bing Ads) accounts.
  • Budget Scale: Proven track record of directly managing paid search budgets of $150K+ per month ($1.5M+ annually) with strict performance goals.
  • Smart Bidding Mastery: Deep, practical expertise with target ROAS (tROAS) bidding, portfolio bid strategies, dynamic value-based bidding, and Smart Bidding mechanics.
  • Campaign Diversity: Extensive experience running and optimizing non-branded search, PMax, and Demand Gen (or Discovery) campaigns.
  • Analytical Skills: Expert-level capability in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, data manipulation), and attribution modeling.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager (GTM), conversion pixels, server-side tracking, and enhanced conversions.
  • Creative Eye: Ability to collaborate on visual and video creative specs tailored for Demand Gen and asset-led formats.
  • Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising certifications.
  • Experience with third-party SEM management tools (e.g., SA360, Marin, Kenshoo/Skai) or bid management scripts.
  • Background in [B2B / E-commerce / Lead Gen - specify your industry].

Your superpowers are…
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong data interpretation abilities with a passion for turning insights into action.
  • Outstanding attention to detail and campaign accuracy.
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to balance short-term performance and long-term growth.
  • Expertise in performance marketing optimization and experimentation.
  • Strong forecasting, budget management, and resource allocation skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities and risks before they impact performance.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Highly organized with strong project and priority management capabilities.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a results-driven mindset.

You should apply if...
  • Passionate about performance marketing and driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Enjoy analyzing data and uncovering insights that lead to growth opportunities.
  • Naturally curious and continuously test, learn, and optimize.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Comfortable managing large budgets and making data-driven decisions.
  • Possess grit and persistence when solving complex performance challenges.
  • Take initiative and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Highly collaborative and enjoy partnering with creative, analytics, and cross-functional teams.
  • Open to feedback and continuously seek ways to improve.
  • Available to work full-time during Eastern Time (ET) business hours and collaborate effectively with a US-based team.
  • Thrive in a remote work environment and can effectively manage time and priorities independently.

Benefits

Permanent Work-From-Home Forever!
Zero commuting, zero traffic, and more time to do what you love.

You get to pick the perfect spot to unleash your creativity and sharpen your problem-solving skills. The possibilities are endless, so let your imagination run wild!

Our day-to-day work puts mental health front and center!
At Magic, we take mental health seriously. It's not just a catchy poster slogan - it's how we live our lives. We believe in listening to our minds and bodies, and if you need a break, take time to recharge and do something that brings you joy!

The synergy of Magic’s community: Monthly Town Hall

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Patient Safety Associate I (Pharmacovigilance Associate, Drug Safety Associate) to join our team. This role supports critical patient safety and pharmacovigilance activities that help ensure the safe and compliant development of therapies for patients worldwide.

As a Patient Safety Associate I, you will contribute to a broad range of safety operations, including individual case safety report processing, safety submissions, literature review activities, affiliate support, regulatory support, and regulatory intelligence activities. Working within established procedures and under appropriate supervision, you will play an important role in maintaining compliance with global regulatory requirements and supporting the delivery of high quality patient safety services.

You will gain exposure to a wide range of pharmacovigilance processes while collaborating with experienced professionals across global teams. This role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in drug safety, regulatory compliance, and clinical research while contributing to activities that help protect patients and support the development of innovative therapies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor incoming safety reports from multiple sources and support timely processing of pharmacovigilance data.
  • Perform data entry, case creation, case processing, quality checks, coding activities, follow up activities, and case narrative preparation within safety databases in accordance with client requirements and standard operating procedures.
  • Support compliance with regulatory reporting requirements through accurate processing, documentation, reconciliation, and tracking of safety cases and submissions.
  • Conduct literature searches, screen and review scientific literature, identify potential safety information, and support literature monitoring activities.
  • Manage submission of Individual Case Safety Reports, periodic reports, and related documentation to regulatory authorities and other stakeholders.
  • Support affiliate services activities, including safety information exchange, literature screening coordination, translation support, follow up activities, and data reconciliation.
  • Maintain documentation, records, and project files in applicable systems, including EDMS and eTMF environments.
  • Support regulatory operations by maintaining regulatory databases, tracking submissions, supporting registrations, and assisting with lifecycle management activities.
  • Participate in regulatory intelligence activities by researching, maintaining, and updating country specific safety reporting requirements and associated records.
  • Participate in project meetings, training programs, audits, inspections, and other assigned departmental activities while escalating issues to supervisors as appropriate.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in organization, attention to detail, and analytical thinking.
  • An interest in pharmacovigilance, patient safety, pharmaceutical development, or healthcare environments.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly.
  • A patient focused mindset and commitment to quality and compliance.
  • Experience working with pharmacovigilance systems, databases, Microsoft Office applications, and established workflows.
  • A strong desire to learn, develop new skills, and contribute to clinical research and patient safety initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences
    (e.g., Pharmacy, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology) or equivalent education/experience.
  • Foundational knowledge of drug safety regulations and pharmacovigilance processes. Ideal candidate has 3+ years experience in Drug Safety.
  • 2+ years experience in post marketing.
  • Experience in multiple therapeutic areas (cardiology, neurology, oncology, rare disease).
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem solving ability.
  • Effective communication and willingness to work in a collaborative team environment.
  • Proficiency with MS Office and ability to learn safety systems/databases. Preference for those with Veeva Safety experience.

Benefits and Compensation

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match
  • Pet Insurance

For a complete list of benefits, please visit .

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes paid time off, a 401(k) match, life insurance, health insurance, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

This role offers the flexibility to work from home in the US.

Position Summary

The Sr. Manager, Category Management, Channels is responsible for leading the strategy, development, and execution of category management initiatives across Mass (Walmart, Target), Club (Costco, Sam's Club, BJ's), Specialty (Trader Joe's, Aldi), and Emerging Channels (Convenience, Drug, Food Service, Hospitality, and other non-traditional retail formats) accounts. This role involves managing and growing relationships with key retail partners, developing channel-specific category strategies that deliver profitable growth, and optimizing product placement and assortments across each of these distinct retail formats. The Sr. Manager will work with our team of category managers and work closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, supply chain, and operations, to ensure the success of channel partnerships and product categories.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers and executives across Mass, Club, Specialty, and Emerging Channel accounts.
  • Develop and implement category management strategies tailored to the distinct needs of each channel, ensuring alignment with both retail partner goals and company objectives.
  • Lead the creation and execution of category plans to drive sales, market share, and profitability within key retailers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for category management, collaborating with retail partners on product assortment, pricing strategies, promotional plans, and go-to-market execution.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen partnerships, enhance category growth, and secure shelf space, ensuring alignment between retailer needs and company objectives.
  • Foster a culture of teamwork and collaboration, ensuring that the category management team is equipped to address the unique needs of each sub-channel.
  • Provide thought leadership to category managers in the execution of account-specific strategies and category optimization, as well as mentorship to sales leads on strategic approach and insights-based story telling with our customers.
  • Internal expert on customer specific data platforms (emphasis on Scintilla and Costco CRX) and leverage insights to inform mutual growth strategies with our customers, as well as shape internal cross functional strategies.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as sales growth, market share, promo effectiveness, HH pen and buy rate, making adjustments as needed to maximize category success.

Non-Essential Job Duties

  • May from time to time need to attend store schematic tests or resets, club roadshows/demos, or other channel-specific retail events.

Job Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in category management, syndicated data, insights, research, sales or a related field.
  • Proven track record in managing relationships and initiatives with large retail accounts across Mass, Club, Specialty, and/or Emerging Channels, while driving sales and category growth.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for strategic decision-making.
  • Extensive use of syndicated scan, panel, and loyalty card platforms, as well as channel-specific retailer portals (e.g., Scintilla, CRX/Unify+ and specialty retailer vendor systems).
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior retail executives and internal stakeholders.

Knowledge

  • Strong MS office suite skills, Nielsen/IRI, space planning, retailer data platforms (Scintilla, CRX, Madrid).

Language Skills

  • Excellent professional oral, written and presentation communication skills.

  • English required.

Other Skills & Abilities

  • Have attention to detail, self-motivated, manage conflicting priorities, meet critical customer & internal deadlines, think creatively and outside of the box, personable, professional, and have strong sense of analytical curiosity.

Major Business/Professional Contacts

  • Regular contact with category management team, sales leads, sales planning, and key retailer contacts.

Working and Environmental Conditions

  • Use of computer, keyboard, and telephone required.

  • Remote home office position with 10% to 20% travel for customer meetings and occasional internal meetings.

  • Due to time zone variations, may require occasional work in the evenings.

Physical Demands

  • Sitting/standing for extended periods of time, sit in front of a computer, light/heavy computer use, speak on the telephone, appear on video conference calls, etc.

Marketing Communications Manager


About the Role

Join a dynamic, global marketing team helping drive growth for a worldwide leader in food and animal safety.


The Marketing Communications Manager will shape and execute integrated marketing communications strategies for a diverse portfolio of solutions that help protect the global food supply. This role will work across regions, functions, and industries to develop compelling campaigns, thought leadership, and customer-focused content that engage audiences throughout the buyer journey.


This position will help advance Neogen’s global marketing capabilities by leveraging data, audience insights, testing, segmentation, and demand generation strategies to increase awareness, engagement, pipeline growth, customer retention, and revenue.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

In this role, you will make an impact by:

  • Developing and executing global integrated marketing communications strategies that strengthen Neogen’s brand positioning across priority food manufacturing industries
  • Creating full-funnel marketing programs designed to drive awareness, engagement, lead generation, pipeline acceleration, customer retention, and revenue growth
  • Leading the development of multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital, print, events, public relations, social media, email, and other relevant channels
  • Developing industry-specific marketing strategies, messaging frameworks, and campaign plans for priority food manufacturing segments and other strategic markets
  • Partnering with segment and regional marketing teams to ensure consistent global messaging while addressing local market needs and opportunities
  • Leading cross-functional campaign planning and execution across Product Marketing, Segment Marketing, Technical, Brand, Design, Regulatory, Legal, and other stakeholders
  • Overseeing development of high-quality content, including white papers, case studies, blog posts, press releases, newsletters, social media content, and other customer-facing materials
  • Translating complex technical and scientific information into clear, compelling content for diverse customer audiences
  • Ensuring content is tailored to target audiences, market segments, customer needs, and communication channels
  • Applying audience segmentation, customer journey mapping, automated nurture programs, re-engagement strategies, and conversion optimization to improve marketing effectiveness
  • Managing the global content calendar and coordinating with internal teams, agencies, and other external partners to support consistent content delivery
  • Supporting development of customer-focused messaging throughout the buyer journey
  • Using marketing performance data, testing, and insights to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Partnering with regional and country marketing teams to align local execution with global strategy
  • Providing guidance and best practices related to marketing communications, campaign development, messaging, and content creation
  • Collaborating with thought leadership teams to support initiatives that position Neogen as a trusted partner and scientific leader across key food and beverage manufacturing sectors
  • Supporting consistent application of Neogen brand standards across global marketing communications
  • Managing multiple concurrent marketing initiatives while maintaining quality, consistency, and timely execution
  • Identifying opportunities to improve marketing processes, content development, campaign execution, and cross-functional collaboration

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing integrated marketing communications, brand marketing, campaign strategy, or related marketing programs
  • Experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns
  • Experience developing messaging, content, or marketing programs for defined customer or industry segments
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and cross-functional workstreams
  • Experience collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners or agencies
  • Experience translating complex technical, scientific, or business information into clear and engaging marketing content
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong project management and organizational skills

raw.description:
We’re hiring a Business Development Manager (full-cycle IC) to launch and validate a new B2B sales motion in the Polish hotel market. This is an MVP role: rather than executing an already-proven playbook, you’ll be the first person testing whether and how hotels buy our Hotel Profit Audit and wider Hotel Profit Management services/solutions — who the real decision-makers are, which messages and channels work, and whether a repeatable sales funnel emerges.

You’ll own the full cycle — prospecting, outreach, discovery, meetings, follow-up and eventually closing the first pilot clients — and report directly to the business owner driving this initiative, with coordination on the BnBerry side.

In the first 90 days, success will be defined by:

1) Researching accounts and identifying real decision-makers (owners/GMs)

2) Booking qualified discovery meetings

3) Keeping disciplined, complete CRM records

4) Capturing structured market feedback (objections, pricing sensitivity, effective messaging) to validate the offer and funnel

You’ll sell into hospitality buyers (owners, GMs) and should bring genuine outbound B2B sales discipline, even if you haven’t sold into hospitality before.

Requirements

Must-have experience & profile

  • 2–5 years in B2B sales / business development, with genuine hands-on cold-outbound experience (not inbound-only)
  • Core skills: prospecting and independently identifying decision-makers, cold calling, email/LinkedIn outreach, discovery, consultative selling
  • Strong CRM discipline: accurate contacts, clear next steps, call summaries, verified decision-makers

• Polish: C1 / native — mandatory

• English: B2+ — mandatory

  • Working style: independent, disciplined, curious, analytical, resilient to rejection
  • Comfortable capturing structured market feedback, not just selling — able to explain your own funnel and reasoning, not just execute a script
  • Comfortable operating without an established playbook, in a fully remote, no-office setup, with occasional fully company-paid travel to hotel meetings

Nice to have

  • Hospitality / hotel-tech / PMS / channel manager / OTA / revenue-tech background — preferred, though strong outbound B2B experience matters more than industry background
  • Prior experience selling a new or pre-validated product at MVP / early-stage
  • Russian: B2+ — materially improves speed and quality of direct feedback and internal discussion.

What “good” looks like

  • Comfortable with sustained daily outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach and follow-ups)
  • Able to explain your own funnel and numbers without checking notes: accounts researched, contacts reached, conversations, qualified meetings, reasons lost
  • Full-cycle ownership: contacts → conversations → qualified meetings → audit interest → proposal → pilot / contract
  • What we weigh most when hiring: real outbound B2B experience and prospecting/decision-maker identification come first, followed by discovery skills, language requirements, independence and CRM discipline — hospitality knowledge is a smaller, nice-to-have factor
  • Automatic no: no cold-outbound experience, inbound-only background, expecting a ready-made database or script, dislike of CRM, inability to explain a previous funnel, not speaking fluent Polish, or pitching on a mock call instead of running discovery

Benefits

• Fully remote / online — no office

  • Business trips for hotel meetings may be required and are fully paid by the company
  • Full-time/Part-time option can also be discussed

The Jed Foundation (JED) seeks a skilled and experienced LMS and Digital Product Administrator to join our team.
