The LMS and Digital Product Administrator works closely with the Educational Programming team to maintain and scale technology-based training that supports JED’s suicide prevention programs, which include school professionals participating in JED Academic Programs, youth-serving community-based organizations and caring adults like parents, caregivers and trusted adults.
To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate must be self-motivated to learn new skills, be well organized, have excellent communication and troubleshooting skills, demonstrate keen attention to detail and be excited about helping shaping technology to scale the impact and reach of JED’s programs.
This is a remote position with approximate 5% travel for internal meetings within the US.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of JED’s Digital Learning ecosystem, including but not limited to: course configuration and set-up, user access configuration (including single-sign-on) for partner organizations, help maintain an integrated resource library, configure surveys and evaluations tied to JED’s training, and maintain environment hygiene and release documentation across sandbox and production, etc.
  • Conduct quality assurance (QA) testing for JED’s Digital Learning ecosystem, including end-to-end testing for registration through certification. Collaborate with instructional designers to test the integration of SCORM packages into the Learning Management System.
  • Pull training data and reports, audit course completions, work with Research & Evaluation Team to ensure accurate data management, generate reports and support data analysis to identify improvement opportunities in the digital delivery and user experience of JED's training programs.
  • Lead the completion of various back-office tasks including, but not limited to, account creation and management, training enrollment management, subscription access management, and training credit management.
  • Help support the implementation of future AI-supported workflows for end-user support and impact reporting. This includes supporting the technical discovery of new AI support tools, prototyping and implementing new processes from concept to delivery.
  • Provide timely and caring end-user support for learners engaging with JED’s Online Training ecosystem, JED staff and partners using The Hub. This includes helping with access and authentication issues, helping troubleshoot technical barriers, triaging cross-department support to resolve issues and communicating remediation with staff and external stakeholders. Operate within a defined support model (tiering, response SLAs, coverage hours, escalation path) and maintain the feedback loop from support into the product backlog by categorizing issues, surfacing recurring themes, and proposing fixes that reduce future volume.
  • Help with technical discovery and planning to support the evolution of JED’s Digital Learning product ecosystem. This includes testing new features offered by our 3rd party LMS, mapping out integration opportunities with The Hub and JED’s website (), and adapting the product over time to meet JED’s evolving org objectives
  • Partner with instructional designers and instructional developers to manage instructor-led training, self-paced modules, videos, knowledge checks, surveys, and training resources within the Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Train, coach, and support internal and external end users as they learn our new platform. This includes the creation and maintenance of end-user and partner-facing training materials.
  • Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that help administrators utilize the system properly.
  • Own the operating cadence for the digital learning and Hub: schedule and prepare recurring planning, refinement, and release ceremonies; produce agendas and notes; and track decisions and action items to closure across product, engineering, instructional design, and program teams.

Core Competencies:
Scope & Execution
  • Have significant experience in your role with fully developed, proven core skills.
  • Make independent decisions about your own work and manage key stakeholders independently.
  • Handle complex problems, larger cross-functional projects, and possibly oversee certain areas of the team's work.
  • Effectively build and communicate project plans and inform department-level budgeting, when appropriate.
Communication
  • Present information clearly and succinctly in a variety of settings/mediums and to a range of audiences.
  • Reflect on communication challenges and opportunities within team and influence change to support better communication.
  • Explain "why" something is important when training or mentoring others.
Collaboration & Cross-Team Impact
  • Exhibit a solid understanding of other teams' perspectives in discussions.
  • Work cross-functionally, with team members at all levels to contribute to business outcomes and execute on projects.
JED Citizenship
  • Are able to negotiate and advocate for your team in a productive, professional way and you prioritize collective benefit over personal gain.
  • Cite and celebrate both individual and team wins.
  • Role model being a help giver; you are committed to helping and supporting others at JED and our external stakeholders.
Learning & Feedback
  • Regularly seek input from your team and manager. You routinely share feedback with others.
  • Take ownership over your career and growth. You seek out and participate in internal and external professional development opportunities; you put learnings into action.
  • Anticipate pitfalls or challenges for core work streams and formulate Plan Bs. When roadblocks occur, you devise and execute solutions to resolve them.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • 3+ years of LMS and Digital Product administration experience, including end-user training and day-to-day support.
  • Knowledge of virtual instructor-led training platforms (such as Zoom or Microsoft Teams).
  • Familiarity with instructional design.
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms (eg: LearnUpon), authoring systems (eg: RISE/Articulate), survey platforms (eg: Qualtrics), content management systems (eg: Contentful), BI and reporting platforms (eg: Google Analytics/Looker) and other integrated learning technologies.
  • Strong decision-making skills working independently and multi-tasking skills working in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and handle service issues with integrity, skill, and professionalism.
  • Stays up to date with the constant change in learning and development to provide relevant advice and guidance related to our LMS.
  • Proven ability to work successfully with diverse populations and demonstrated commitment to promoting diversity and inclusion.

Success Metrics
  • Courses and platform releases launch with QA issues identified and resolved before go-live.
  • Training data reports are accurate and delivered on the agreed cadence, supporting Research & Evaluation's data needs.
  • End-user support tickets are resolved within defined SLAs, with recurring issues surfaced and reduced over time through backlog feedback.
  • The digital learning and Hub operating cadence (planning, refinement, release ceremonies) runs on schedule with decisions and action items tracked to closure.

Job Description

Job Description

The KHI Sales Analyst will drive business growth by leveraging data analysis and insights to identify strategic opportunities with Kraft Heinz Ingredients (KHI) customers, managing the KHI Sales Pipeline, and ensuring accurate tracking and reporting. The analyst will also maintain Salesforce as a reliable tool for sales performance tracking and pipeline trends, track and report on the ZBB sales budget, and collaborate with other analysts to incorporate best practices. Additionally, the analyst will develop customer-specific selling stories using data from various sources and create data reports to analyze trends, ultimately supporting key business building initiatives and driving sales team success.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Leverage data analysis and insights to identify and pursue strategic growth opportunities with Kraft Heinz Ingredients (KHI) customers, driving business expansion and revenue growth through data-driven decision making and collaborative partnership development
  • Own and manage the KHI Sales Pipeline, overseeing data management, opportunity tracking, and pipeline calls, while ensuring accurate tracking, timely reporting, and proactive communication to drive sales team success.
  • Ensure that Salesforce remains a reliable and accurate tool for tracking sales performance, monitoring pipeline trends, and supporting strategic decisions.
  • Track and report on the ZBB sales budget to ensure transparency and financial alignment.
  • Collaborate with peers and cross functionally to ensure KHI incorporates efficient ways of working and best practices
  • Integrate data from a variety of sources to develop impactful customer-specific selling stories in support of key category business building initiatives.
  • Utilize data platforms like Clearview and Tableau to design, develop, and maintain data reports to track key performance indicators, identify trends, and provide actionable insights that inform business decisions. These insights will be shared with the Sales Director and National Account Managers to proactively understand our opportunities with customers.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years+ years of experience in analytics, sales, customer management and/or account management, preferably for a CPG company.
  • Excellent planning, oral, and written communication.
  • Experience in applying a customer-first mentality for effective customer management and selling to achieve objectives.
  • Strong analytical skills; Use and understanding of syndicated data; develop comprehensive business plans by analyzing category and segment performance and influences customer to achieve category objectives.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Excel skills to include working with V-lookups, Pivot Tables, and miscellaneous data aggregation, manipulation formulas.
  • Results-driven professional with proven ability to prioritize tasks and responsibilities effectively, ensuring timely completion of high-priority projects and delivering exceptional results in fast-paced environments
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%

The contents of this role profile outline the role and responsibilities of the SVP, Services Procurement Advisory and should be reviewed in conjunction with the Delegation of Authority, Organization Design Principles, RACI, Virtuoso Framework, and Leadership attributes.

Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, the SVP, Services Procurement Advisory is responsible for establishing and scaling a high-impact advisory practice focused on services procurement, supply chain optimization, and workforce-related spend transformation with enterprise and mid-market-level organizations. This role will drive enterprise consulting revenue, thought leadership, and strategic client engagement, positioning the organization as a trusted advisor to CPOs, CFOs, CHROs, and CIOs navigating complex procurement and workforce transformation initiatives.

Key Consulting Offerings:

Ideal candidate will have worked in an advisory environment serving enterprise through mid-market organizations, providing the following services:

  • Services Procurement Strategy & Transformation (MSP, SOW, and total services spend)

  • Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Optimization (rationalization, segmentation, and consolidation)

  • Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Operating Model Design

  • Global Procurement Centralization & Governance Models

  • Supplier Risk, Compliance & Responsible Buying Advisory

  • Workforce & Services Spend Integration (Total Talent / Total Workforce strategies)

  • Procurement Technology Performance (Zip, Coupa, Zivio, VMS, and related products)

Core Responsibilities: -

Sales & Business Development

Ideal candidate will have previous experience performing the following:

  • Owning and exceeding global revenue targets for Services Procurement Advisory, driving growth across enterprise accounts and priority markets.

  • Developing and executing go-to-market strategies focused on procurement transformation, advisory-led MSP/SOW expansion, and consulting-led solution selling.

  • Building and maintaining C-level client relationships (CPO, CFO, CHRO, CIO), establishing trusted advisor status and shaping large-scale transformation agendas.

  • Identifying cross-sell opportunities across MSP, SOW, consulting, and digital solutions—linking advisory insights to long-term managed services engagements.

  • Driving large, complex deal origination and closure, including sourcing transformation, procurement outsourcing, and workforce-services integration programs.

Practice Leadership

  • Define the global vision, strategy, and operating model for Services Procurement Advisory, aligned to enterprise growth priorities.

  • Build and lead a high-performing, global advisory team of procurement SMEs, consultants, and industry experts.

  • Establish best-in-class consulting methodologies, frameworks, and delivery models for services procurement transformation.

  • Ensure delivery excellence across engagements, including governance, KPIs, value realization tracking, and client satisfaction.

  • Drive large-scale transformation initiatives including global sourcing centralization, supplier rationalization, and procurement operating model redesign.

Thought Leadership & Market Positioning

  • Position the firm as a market leader in services procurement and supply chain advisory, particularly at the intersection of workforce and services spend.

  • Represent the practice at industry forums, executive roundtables, and conferences, enhancing market credibility.

  • Develop POVs, whitepapers, and executive content on:

    • Future of services procurement

    • AI and automation in sourcing

    • Total workforce and spend orchestration

    • Supplier ecosystem optimization

  • Act as a senior strategic advisor enterprise and mid-market clients, guiding procurement transformation and operating model decisions.

Financial & Operational Management

  • Manage P&L for the consulting practice. Ensure financial health and profitability. Optimize resource allocation and scalability.

  • Forecast revenue, monitor performance, and ensure profitability. Maintain accurate financial projections and performance metrics. Use forecasting models, dashboards, and regular reviews to adjust strategies proactively.

  • Implement scalable processes and methodologies for consistent delivery. Standardize operations for efficiency and quality. Develop SOPs, leverage technology platforms, and train teams on best practices.

Key Skills & Experience:

  • Proven track record in a professional services or management consulting firm, with demonstrated success engaging C-suite and senior executives across large enterprise and mid-market organizations; U.S.-based experience required.

  • Proven methodology for assessing and diagnosing services procurement functions using data analytics, translating findings into clear recommendations and solutions—including the transition of functions to third-party partners.

  • Deep understanding of services procurement (SOW, MSP, indirect spend), strategic sourcing and supplier management; and procurement operating models and P2P transformation.

  • Combination of advisory and solutioning experience, business development responsibilities with accountability for sales practice growth, and prior services procurement/SOW and spend management responsibilities held within a corporate function.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P&L.

  • Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders (C-suite level).

  • Expertise in workforce analytics, talent strategy, and EVP development, with workforce solutions experience that provides insight into how organizations are evolving their broader extended workforce and professional services utilization.

  • Leadership experience in building and scaling consulting teams.

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field.

  • Professional certifications in Procurement or Supply Chain (CPSM, CSCP, or equivalent) (desirable).

This role profile sets out the purpose and main elements of the role. It is a guide to the nature and main duties as they currently exist but is not intended as a wholly comprehensive or permanent schedule and is not a contractual document. This document may be amended to meet the changing needs of the business.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.

This role will work within our innovative Data & Technology group that continues to evolve to meet business needs, fuel Parexel's growth and enable improved support for stakeholders, including customers and ultimately patients, who will benefit from Parexel's integrated processes and systems.

This role can be based in the UK, Serbia, Romania or Poland and can be fully home based in any of those countries.

As the Senior Business Analyst you will work as part of our IT Business Engagement & Enablement department and partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to uncover the true needs of the organization and translate them into clear, actionable, and testable requirements. This role ensures solutions are designed with the end user in mind while meeting enterprise, quality, and regulatory expectations.

In this role you will:

Elicit and define business requirements

  • Identify true business needs using a consulting mindset, distinguishing between “need” and “want.”

  • Gather, analyze, and refine business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and documentation reviews.

  • Produce clear, complete, and unambiguous requirements documentation, including functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

Maintain traceability and support test coverage

  • Own and maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to ensure all requirements are fully tested.

  • Partner with QA, Technology Quality Management, and delivery teams to validate requirements, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.

  • Support the definition of User Acceptance Test (UAT) criteria and scenarios and participate in UAT preparation, dry runs, and execution as needed.

Facilitate workshops and stakeholder alignment

  • Facilitate and co-chair workshops, interviews, and working sessions with cross-functional SMEs and stakeholders.

  • Drive collaborative agreement, prioritization, and decision-making across business and technology teams.

  • Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and functional leaders to align on scope and outcomes.

Translate business needs to technology delivery

  • Act as the primary translator between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring shared understanding of requirements and solution intent.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer within Scrum or delivery teams when a business SME is not embedded.

  • Assist in identifying technical capabilities and solution approaches that align with desired business outcomes.

  • Partner with UX and Human Factors Engineering (HFE) specialists to ensure requirements support intuitive, user-centered solution design.

Enable continuous improvement ​

  • Apply Business Analysis best practices to continuously improve processes, standards, templates, and ways of working.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency while maintaining quality and compliance.

  • Contribute to the maturity of Business Analysis practices across initiatives and programs.

You will require the following skills:

  • Strong consulting skills, including root cause analysis and the ability to distinguish between true needs and stated wants.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex discussions into structured documentation.

  • Proven ability to negotiate, influence, and build consensus with senior stakeholders.

  • Strong requirements documentation and analytical skills.

  • Ability to learn new domains quickly and share knowledge effectively across teams.

  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, cross-functional, and globally distributed environments.

  • Comfortable balancing multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience with generative AI is preferential, including; requirements drafting and refinement, process analysis and optimisation, workshop acceleration, test case support and backlog grooming assistance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, or relevant discipline required.

  • MSc/MBA/advanced degree preferred.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Advanced level Senior Business Analyst IT experience working in a technical environment within a regulated industry is essential.

  • A strong understanding of clinical trials and previous CRO, Pharma or Biotech industry domain experience is desirable.

  • A solid grounding in Business Analysis best practices and consulting behaviors.

  • Familiarity with Computer System Validation (CSV), SDLC methodologies, and 21 CFR Part 11 concepts.

  • Experience working within regulated environments such as pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO organizations.

  • Experience supporting project delivery within established Project Lifecycle (PLC) frameworks.

In return we will be able to offer you a structured career pathway and encouragement to develop within the role including awareness and understanding of the industry. You will be well supported and in return for your hard work you will be rewarded with a competitive base salary, holiday as well as other leading benefits you would expect with a top company in the CRO Industry.

Apply today to begin your Parexel journey!

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a HPC Performance Engineer in our NVHPC compilers & tools group. Our performance engineers analyze High Performance Computing (HPC) applications with the intent of improving performance by driving compiler optimizations and library enhancements. This role offers the chance to work with a wide range of applications, from small benchmarks running on single-CPU core to full-scale applications running on multi-node multi-GPU systems. You'll find optimization opportunities and work closely with our compiler development and application engineering teams to deliver effective solutions.

What you'll be doing:

  • Analyze the effect of different compilers and compiler optimizations on HPC application performance.

  • Evaluate whether and how the compiler and runtime can improve the performance of key HPC applications on CPU and CPU/GPU platforms.

  • Communicate limits of compiler capabilities with application engineering to guide the best path forward towards improving performance.

  • Port HPC applications to different platforms and programming models.

  • Evaluate the impact of NVHPC package components, device driver, and system configuration on application performance.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related engineering field.

  • 5+ years of programming experience.

  • Solid understanding of Fortran, C, C++, and programming techniques, especially for parallel architectures, preferably for compilers.

  • Experience with OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, CUDA and Standard Language Parallelism.

  • Strong skills in performance analysis and tuning, as well as a broad understanding of parallel applications development tools and runtime environments.

  • Strong mathematical fundamentals, including linear algebra and numerical methods.

  • Understand performance considerations, tradeoffs, and impact.

  • Expert interpersonal skills, a logical approach to problem-solving, good time management, and task prioritization skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with the ability to work in a dynamic development team.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • You have a deep understanding of machine architectures and micro-architectures.

  • Experience with debugging and porting as well as assembly language programming is a significant advantage.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

raw.title: Design Lead
raw.excerpt: Summit K12 is building a lean, modern design function — and you'll be at the center of it.
raw.description:
Summit K12 is building a lean, modern design function — and you'll be at the center of it. As a Design Lead, you own the user experience for your product area and co-steward our shared design system, while staying hands-on in Figma every day. This is a player-coach role: you will design, lead our design efforts, and partner closely with Product Managers as a trusted consultant, helping bridge the gap between our design and product teams to ensure cohesive, high-quality outcomes.

We're a customer-driven, growing company — many of us came from the classrooms and districts we serve, so deep user knowledge lives in-house. We move fast: rather than lengthy research cycles, we validate with the educator expertise on our own team and quick feedback from real users. We're looking for someone who ships confidently without waiting for perfect data, uses AI tools to multiply their output, and earns influence through craft and judgment rather than title or process.

Key Responsibilities

Steward the Design System

  • Maintain and evolve the Summit K12 design system — components, patterns, typography, color, accessibility standards, and interaction behaviors
  • Keep the system documented, versioned, and genuinely used, so teams move faster with it than without it
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure components are technically feasible and consistently implemented
  • Drive adoption — you and your fellow Design Leads share accountability for the system actually being used across teams, reducing UX fragmentation through enablement and reusable patterns rather than policing
  • Decide, jointly with your fellow Design Leads, what enters the system and when projects in your area can deviate from it, escalating consequential additions, cross-product deviations, and any calls the leads can't align on.

Consult with Product

  • Act as a design consultant and force multiplier to Product Managers — in a world where a PM can spin up an AI prototype in an afternoon, you're the one who makes it shippable: coherent, accessible, and on-system
  • Engage early in discovery to shape solutions, not just review them at the end
  • Make the case for design through outcomes — demonstrate how strong UX reduces rework, support burden, and churn
  • Be the Design Lead your teams trust for day-to-day design calls

Design, Hands-On

  • Spend real time in Figma — this is a shipping role, not a pure oversight role
  • Translate platform experience strategy into concrete, consistent navigation, workflows, and interaction patterns across all user types
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, v0, Figma AI) to accelerate design and development workflows
  • Integrate Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles into the design system so interaction patterns work for the full range of learner abilities

Validate Lean

  • Use lightweight validation — heuristic reviews, quick user feedback loops, analytics, and support signals — in place of heavyweight research studies
  • Know when a decision needs evidence and when experienced judgment is enough
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and simplicity in every experience

Set The Standard

  • Set clear expectations for quality, ownership, and accountability
  • Run lean design workflows in Figma and Jira that support fast iteration and predictable delivery
  • Foster a culture of user empathy, experimentation, and low-ego collaboration
  • Lead, mentor and develop the designers you work with

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • 6+ years in product/UX design, including owning a design system
  • Experience leading or mentoring designers while staying hands-on
  • Fluency in Figma and comfort managing design work in Jira
  • Active use of AI tools in your design workflow, and enthusiasm for operating as an AI-leveraged, lean design function
  • Strong grounding in user-centered design, interaction design, and Universal Design for Learning
  • Experience with WCAG accessibility standards, including interpreting ACRs and driving remediation
  • A track record of building design cohesion through cross-functional partnership — influence earned, not imposed
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment: shipping without waiting for perfect data, with limited resources and tight timelines

Preferred

  • EdTech experience, or deep accessibility/UDL work that translates quickly to K-12 contexts
  • Experience designing SaaS or platform-based products
  • Understanding of the workflows and daily realities of teachers, school administrators, and district leaders
  • Experience collaborating with distributed or global teams across time zones
  • Experience in lean or scaling organizations

How We'll Know It's Working

  • A single, consistently applied design system across all products
  • Product Managers seek out design partnership because it makes their features better and faster to ship
  • Reduced UX inconsistency and rework during development
  • Faster delivery through reusable patterns and clear standards
  • Positive usability feedback from teachers, students, and administrators

Benefits

Summit K12 offers a comprehensive benefits package. Highlights include:
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with multiple plan options
  • Company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) program
  • 10 paid holidays plus 1 floating holiday annually
  • Wellness resources and support programs
Summit K12 is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

raw.title: Technical Account Manager
raw.excerpt: About the role: The Technical Account Manager owns the post-sale technical relationship with Semarchy's most strategic customers.
raw.description:
About the role:

The Technical Account Manager owns the post-sale technical relationship with Semarchy's most strategic customers. As Semarchy evolves its customer engagement into a technical-led model, the TAM brings deep product expertise, architectural perspective, and outcome ownership to every account — the technical partner who turns a Semarchy investment into realized business value.
TAMs partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers, who own the executive relationship and commercial motion, and with CX Operations, which owns health scoring and renewal forecasting. TAMs report to the regional Director of Technical Account Management.

Nice to Have

Nice to have
  • Experience supporting customers through a platform transition (legacy MDM to modern MDM, on-prem to SaaS).
  • Snowflake or other cloud data platform certifications.
  • Background in a regulated or data-intensive industry (financial services, healthcare/life sciences, retail, manufacturing).
  • Multilingual capability for EMEA-based roles (French, German, Spanish, or Italian).
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

What You'll Own

What you'll own:

Customer outcomes and success plans. Co-own success plans with Sales counterparts for each customer in your portfolio — capturing business outcomes, technical milestones, and the path from initial deployment through expansion. Deliver against agreed outcomes, track value realization, and surface risk early. Run Strategic Business Reviews alongside Sales, bringing the technical narrative and roadmap alignment.

Technical advisory and platform optimization. Serve as the customer's senior technical advisor across Semarchy products — architecture, data model design, matching strategy, integration patterns, and UI/UX. Conduct expert reviews of critical functionality, optimize existing use cases, and proactively identify opportunities to deepen utilization. Advise beyond the platform itself — best practices, operating model, and industry alignment — to help customers get the most from their investment.

Adoption, expansion, and growth. Drive product adoption and utilization as the foundation of every account. Identify and shape in-scope expansion — new domains, use cases, and data locations — through technical roadmap alignment, and partner with Sales to qualify and develop expansion pipeline with technical credibility and a feasibility view. Support customers transitioning from Semarchy xDM to SDP within their broader modernization timeline.

Relationship ownership and renewal readiness. Own the on-the-ground technical relationship, typically with customer architects, data leads, and platform owners, and act as their escalation point into Semarchy — coordinating with Support, Product, and Engineering as needed. Deliver advanced enablement to customer and partner teams, enforce Semarchy best practices across implementations (including partner-delivered work), and provide input into health scoring and renewal readiness, flagging risk early and partnering with CX Ops on at-risk accounts.

What you'll bring:
  • 7+ years in a senior post-sales technical role — TAM, Solutions Architect, Customer Success Engineer, or equivalent.
  • Strong technical expertise in master data management, data integration, or modern data platforms. Direct Semarchy experience (xDM, SDP, xDI) is strongly preferred.
  • Strong architectural fluency: data modeling, matching and survivorship, integration patterns, security, and cloud deployment topologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical capability into business outcomes — credible with both customer architects and business stakeholders.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of 5-10 strategic enterprise customers simultaneously, balancing depth with consistency.
  • A track record of identifying and shaping expansion — not just renewing — within an existing customer base.
  • Strong written and verbal communication: can run a workshop, write a clean technical recommendation, and represent Semarchy at a customer executive meeting with equal confidence.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Join our distributed sales team across Germany and the United States, united by a passion for innovative technology and a shared mission to help our customers become industry leaders. You will be at the forefront of one of the most significant shifts in engineering history - selling Synera's AI Agent Platform to the companies that build our physical world. This role is ideal for a proactive and results-oriented sales professional who excel at expanding existing opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and increasing market penetration to deliver sustained impact.

  • Monday: You start the week with a Team Kick-Off to review goals and align on priorities, while engaging in outbound activities and reaching out to potential leads.

  • Tuesday: You focus on qualifying the leads by pitching Synera and conducting demos to showcase its value.

  • Wednesday: you conduct thorough use case screenings and deep dives with potential customers to qualify opportunities, and sync with your team lead, Markus.

  • Thursday: You drive the closing process, aiming to finalize deals and secure new business partnerships.

  • Friday: You use this time to refine strategies, seek feedback, and plan for continuous improvement in your role.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You achieve your first win(s) by successfully closing an opportunity!

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You continue growing our customer base.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • You're in the front row of an AI transformation - selling a product that is actively changing how the world's top engineering teams work, not a commodity.

  • You collaborate with innovative customers and top companies like Hyundai, ArianeSpace and NASA.

  • You take on responsibility from day one, empowering you to make impactful decisions and drive real success.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🌱 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • Proven B2B SaaS Sales Expertise: You bring a strong track record of success in selling technically complex software solutions within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Established Industry Network: You possess an active and well-developed network of relevant contacts within our target market, enabling you to generate and accelerate business opportunities.

  • Engineering Domain Expertise: You have an engineering background or hands-on experience working with or selling engineering software (e.g., CAD, CAE, PLM, or similar solutions), enabling you to effectively engage with technical stakeholders and understand customer challenges.

  • Executive-Level Engagement: You are skilled at building relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders and bring an existing portfolio of relevant accounts within our industry.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Sales team.

raw.title: Senior Account Manager, Retail Media
raw.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart’s retail media platform, Carrot Ads, is scaling fast — and the strategic retail partners who power it need more than a point of contact. They need a trusted advisor who knows their business, knows ours, and can translate that into advertising performance that grows over time. Without this role, we risk leaving adoption on the table, missing signals from partners who could shape our product roadmap, and letting high-potential relationships stagnate. We’re hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of enterprise retail partners end-to-end — from onboarding through growth — and make Carrot Ads an indispensable part of how they compete. This role sits at the center of Instacart’s retail media expansion, with a direct line of sight to partner revenue, product adoption, and the future of how we go to market.

What you’ll cook up in your first year

  • A portfolio of strategic enterprise retail partners is measurably healthier — adoption is up, revenue is growing, and partners are pointing to Carrot Ads as a competitive advantage.
  • New retail partners are onboarded smoothly and confidently — trained on campaign tooling, demand sourcing, reporting, and invoicing — so they hit the ground running and don’t stall out early.
  • Partners are adopting expanded placements and new product capabilities because you’ve made the incremental revenue case clearly — and Product teams have better data to work with because of the feedback loops you’ve built.
  • The account management practice is sharper than when you arrived — playbooks are tighter, QBR formats are more compelling, and the team has better tools for tracking partner KPIs and scaling what works.
  • Cross-functional partners — from Business Development to Finance to Ads Quality — know who to call when something involves the retail partner book, because you’ve become the connective tissue across teams.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years in Account Management or a related field, with experience in ad tech, publishers, or retail media.
  • Proven experience supporting enterprise solutions in the advertising space, including managing complex partner relationships end-to-end.
  • Strong technical acumen — able to understand and explain complex product capabilities to partners who may not be technical.
  • Proficient in data analysis with the ability to derive actionable insights and make strategic recommendations from partner KPI data.
  • Comfortable navigating billing, invoicing, and revenue reconciliation workflows in partnership with Finance.
  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to distill complex concepts for varied audiences — from technical teams to executive stakeholders.
  • Proven project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple partner relationships and internal workstreams simultaneously.
  • Experienced in cross-functional collaboration and executive-level presentations.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Specific industry experience in advertising, grocery, and/or e-commerce.
  • Proven track record of building growth narratives and revenue-driving strategies for enterprise retail partners.
  • Experience in collaborative management of enterprise accounts alongside sales teams in a partner-facing environment.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

$157,000—$165,500 USD

OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$144,000—$152,000 USD
All other states
$131,000—$138,000 USD

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The Opportunity

Are you a conversation starter with high energy and a "hunter" mentality? Design Develop Now (DDN) is looking for a 100% commissioned Digital Services Sales Specialist to focus on Appointment Setting.

In this role, you aren’t responsible for closing the final contract or managing long-term projects. Your mission is simple: Identify prospects, start the conversation, and set an appointment. This is a commission-only role designed for high-activity individuals who want to be rewarded directly for every qualified meeting they set.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • The "First Touch": Engage in proactive cold calling and email outreach to introduce businesses to our web design and digital marketing services.

  • Lead Generation: Identify and qualify new B2B leads, ensuring they are a good fit for our design and development solutions.

  • Set the Stage: Successfully schedule high-quality appointments/demos for our senior design consultants.

  • CRM Management: Log all outreach activity and lead status in Zoho (or similar CRM) to ensure no prospect falls through the cracks.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the closing team to provide them with the "intel" they need to win the deal.

Why Join Us?

  • Streamlined Focus: You focus on the "top of the funnel"—booking meetings—without the stress of long-term account management.

  • Lucrative Commissions: Earn competitive commissions for every qualified appointment set or deal closed from your leads.

  • Full Training: We provide the scripts, the CRM access, and the product knowledge you need to be successful.

  • Flexibility: Perfect for those who want to work independently and control their own schedule.


Requirements

Requirements

  • Communication: A professional, persuasive, and friendly phone presence. You should be comfortable "breaking the ice."

  • Experience: Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or inside sales is a big plus. We will train the right personality!

  • Tech-Savvy: Basic understanding of what makes a good website and how digital marketing helps businesses grow.

  • Resilience: A positive attitude and the ability to bounce back from "no" to get to the "yes."

  • Self-Starter: The discipline to manage your own daily call volume and hit weekly appointment targets.

deine position

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As Chief of Staff to the Go-to-Market Director, you are the operational backbone that keeps the go-to-market engine running at full speed across all markets.   • You coordinate closely with Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing across markets, following up on commitments and ensuring cross-functional initiatives stay on track.

  • You constantly look for ways to improve how the Go-to-Market function operates, bringing structure and rigour to a fast-moving, scaling environment.

dein profil

  • You bring at least 3 to 5 years of experience in a Chief of Staff, business operations, analyst, or similar high-rigour role, ideally within tech, scale-ups, or energy.

  • You are exceptionally detail-oriented and accurate, with a natural instinct for catching what others miss.

  • You are proactive by nature: you don't wait to be told what to do, you anticipate what's needed, take initiative, and only ask for help or authority when it genuinely matters.

  • You have strong project management skills, able to build the architecture and structure that keeps complex, multi-market projects on track.

  • You are highly structured and organised by default, able to juggle multiple workstreams and deadlines without losing the thread.

  • You are strong with data and analytics, comfortable turning numbers into clear, actionable insight.

  • You are a fast, reliable executor who thrives on turning big-picture priorities into next-day, on-the-ground action.

  • Fluency in German and English (C1/C2) is required, written and verbal.

benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) with a strong B2B technology, enterprise software, ERP, or related background to support an international technology and digital transformation client.

This is a B2B outbound role focused on account-based prospecting, research, and engaging senior decision-makers within the automotive and related industries.

You will be responsible for researching target companies, identifying the right decision-makers, conducting personalized outreach, qualifying potential opportunities, and booking qualified meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Research and identify high-potential target accounts.

Identify and engage relevant senior decision-makers within target organizations.

Conduct outbound outreach through cold calling, LinkedIn, email, and other approved channels.

Personalize outreach based on each prospect's business, operations, and potential needs.

Qualify prospects and identify genuine business opportunities.

Build professional conversations with senior stakeholders.

Schedule qualified meetings for the sales team.

Maintain accurate prospecting and activity records in the CRM.

Represent the client professionally across all communication channels.

Consistently work toward monthly qualified meeting targets.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in B2B outbound sales, business development, or sales development.
  • Previous experience selling or prospecting for B2B technology, enterprise software, ERP, SaaS, IT solutions, or digital transformation services.
  • Strong experience with account research and targeted prospecting.
  • Experience engaging senior-level and enterprise decision-makers.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong cold calling, LinkedIn, and email outreach skills.
  • Ability to understand and communicate complex B2B technology solutions.
  • Experience using CRM and sales prospecting tools.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Experience with SAP solutions, automotive technology, automotive dealer networks, or enterprise digital transformation is a strong advantage.

Performance Expectations

This role focuses on quality, research, and targeted outreach rather than generic mass prospecting.

The SDR will be expected to identify the right accounts, engage relevant senior stakeholders, qualify genuine opportunities, and generate attended qualified meetings.

Benefits

Remote setup

$500 USD monthly base salary + commission.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.
Role details

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Remote — United States

  • Reports to: Co-founders

  • Salary range: $70,000 - $100,000 USD, depending on experience

About Wanderlog

Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.

Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.

We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.

Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu (ex-Stripe, McKinsey) and Harry Yu (ex-Google), who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.

What you'll do

As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:

  • Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
  • Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
  • Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
  • Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
  • Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
  • Review code written by other engineers.
  • Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.
What you might work on
  • New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
  • AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
  • Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
  • A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
  • Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
  • A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.
What it's like to work here

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

Hiring process
  • Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
  • A live coding interview with one of the founders
  • A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

Requirements

  • Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
  • Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
  • Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
  • Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
  • Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

Benefits

  • Medical
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • FSA or HSA plans
  • Paid sick leave

raw.description:
Job Title:

Solutions Marketing Manager - APJ

About Trellix 
Trellix is a global company redefining the future of cybersecurity. The company’s comprehensive, open, and native cybersecurity platform helps organizations confronted by today’s most advanced threats gain confidence in the protection and resilience of their operations. Trellix, along with an extensive partner ecosystem, accelerates technology innovation through artificial intelligence, automation, and analytics to empower over 50,000 business and government customers with responsibly architected security. More at .

Role Overview:

The Solutions Marketing Manager is responsible for bridging the gap between global marketing and product strategy and the specific needs of the APJ market. While global teams produce a high volume of GTM content, this role ensures those assets are adapted, packaged, and distributed effectively for regional sales teams and channel partners.

You will act as the connective layer between global product marketing, field marketing, ABM, and channel teams, ensuring that messaging remains relevant, culturally nuanced, and usable. This role will create new materials relevant to specific legislation and regulatory requirements, while also strategically adapting existing materials to drive partner enablement and sales productivity across the region.

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Adapt and localise global product marketing updates, sales plays and other sales materials into market-relevant formats for APJ sales and channel audiences.

  • Manage translation workflows and maintain vendor relationships across priority APJ languages.

  • Translate global messaging for local market nuances while maintaining strict brand and product positioning guardrails.

  • Build, maintain, and execute eDM and newsletter programs for internal (sales) and external (channel) audiences.

  • Develop and scale reusable content templates and playbooks for Field Marketing Managers (FMMs) and ABM team to drive efficiency.

  • Package content into structured bundles with distinct messaging tracks for sales and partner audiences

  • Own and maintain the APJ partner portal, ensuring content remains current with global updates.

  • Localize global demand generation and thought leadership campaigns for APJ

  • Adapt global demand generation and thought leadership campaigns for partner implementation

  • Act as the strategic connective layer between global product marketing, global solutions marketing, APJ field marketing, ABM, and channel teams.

  • Proactively identify and flag content gaps before they impact sales or partner activities.

  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness and adoption of distributed content.

3. Role Requirements

  • 4-7 years of experience in marketing content or communications.

  • Demonstrated experience in the Cybersecurity or SaaS industry is a must.

  • Proven track record of managing APJ regional marketing initiatives.

  • Fluency in spoken and written English is required. Business proficiency in Chinese, Mandarin, or Japanese is highly advantageous to effectively communicate across key regional markets but not required.

  • Experience working with global content teams and adapting output for regional markets.

  • Strong writing skills with the discipline to adhere to established brand and messaging guardrails.

  • Hands-on experience owning translation and localization vendor relationships.

  • Familiarity with portal/CMS management and marketing automation platforms.

  • Strong APJ market or cultural familiarity.

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, Individual Contributor capacity.

4. Candidate Profile

  • Strategic thinker capable of balancing global brand consistency with local market relevance.

  • Detail-oriented operator who excels at workflow management and vendor coordination.

  • Collaborative partner who can build relationships across cross-functional teams (Sales, FMMs, Channel, Product Marketing).

  • Proactive problem-solver with an analytical mindset toward content adoption and process improvement.

  • Adaptable professional comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment where speed-to-market is critical.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to distill complex global messaging into actionable local assets.

Company Benefits and Perks:

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

  • Retirement Plans

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

  • Paid Time Off

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Our Commitment to You:

At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.

Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

raw.description:
Job Summary

Aptive Resources is seeking an AI Subject Matter Expert with more than fifteen years of experience in the life sciences industry focused on creating and delivering data science and artificial intelligence solutions that accelerate healthcare innovation. In this role you will be Aptive’s senior AI advisor supporting the Veterans Health Administration’s National Artificial Intelligence Institute by writing the playbooks and risk management guidance that VHA AI use case owners rely on, advising the governance bodies that decide which AI systems reach Veterans, and helping business units across the enterprise build AI strategies that hold up under federal scrutiny. The role is advisory throughout: you will equip and advise government decision-makers rather than make agency decisions. This senior level, full-time position is remote. This is a contingent hire position.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the contractor team’s senior AI technical advisor to the VHA National AI Institute across the AI inventory, risk management, oversight, and enterprise strategy workstreams.
  • Author and maintain AI risk management playbooks, standard operating procedures, guides, and living FAQ documents that enable AI use case owners to satisfy federal and agency risk management requirements.
  • Translate federal AI policy into practical, actionable guidance for a non-specialist VHA audience (Executive Order 13960, OMB M-25-21 and M-25-22, and the VA Trustworthy AI Framework).
  • Advise AI use case owners on the development and execution of AI risk management plans through working sessions, office hours, and asynchronous support, at a cadence of at least one working session per month.
  • Design and execute the AI risk stratification pilot, including a new methodology for evaluating and assigning risk levels to AI systems, and evaluate its results.
  • Support VHA business units in creating and updating their AI innovation and governance strategies, covering at least five business units.
  • Develop training materials and deliver training webinars for AI use case owners and AI oversight personnel.
  • Provide expert content and programming for the VHA AI Assessment Subcommittee, field AI committees, and other centralized governance entities, including trainings and summits.
  • Research emerging AI risk management approaches and tools from published and publicly available literature, webinars, and vendor developments for briefings to Institute leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Develop AI entrepreneur and adopter playbooks covering both internal development and vendor evaluation pathways.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Years of experience: More than 15 years of experience in the life sciences industry with a focus on creating and delivering data science and artificial intelligence solutions to accelerate healthcare innovation. Preferred: eight or more of those years developing or applying AI tools inside a healthcare enterprise at scale.
  • Required experience: Previous experience leading efforts to aggregate, analyze, and interpret health information. Previous experience developing new processes, solutions, and information architectures that leverage a variety of data types including medical images, electronic health records, wearable data, and -omics data. Previous experience using data platforms to scale machine learning algorithms through a ModelOps AI platform.
  • Degree: Doctorate degree in a computational, data science, health informatics, clinical, or life sciences discipline. Any doctorate is eligible, including a DrPH, MD, PhD, or ScD.
  • Licensure/certifications: None required. NIST AI Risk Management Framework training or an equivalent AI governance credential preferred.
  • Work location: Work is performed at the contractor’s site and no travel is anticipated.
  • Clearance: None required. Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated Tier 1 / National Agency Check with Written Inquiries (NACI) background investigation in accordance with VA Handbook 0710. Must complete VA Privacy and Information Security Awareness and Rules of Behavior training (TMS #10176) prior to system access and annually thereafter.
  • Citizenship: Must be authorized to work in the United States. All work must be performed within a jurisdiction subject to the law of the United States or its territories.

Desired Qualifications

  • Command of the federal AI policy and governance landscape, including EO 13960, OMB M-25-21 and M-25-22, the VA Trustworthy AI Framework, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Demonstrated ability to move fluidly between deeply technical AI discussion and executive-level strategy conversation with non-technical leadership.
  • Experience standing up or operating an AI use case inventory, model registry, or comparable enterprise AI transparency mechanism.
  • Experience aggregating, analyzing, and interpreting health information across imaging, EHR, wearable, and -omics data types.
  • Familiarity with ModelOps or comparable platforms for scaling machine learning algorithms in production.
  • Prior VA, VHA, DoD health, or other federal health agency experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience advising clinical stakeholders on AI risk in a health system setting.
  • Familiarity with VA Arches or comparable accredited federal AI and analytics environments.
  • Experience authoring governance artifacts such as charters, playbooks, SOPs, assessment guides that were actually adopted and used by an operating organization.
  • Ability to get up to speed quickly on complex issues; desire to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.
  • Capable self-starter with a drive to get all types of work done and high attention to detail.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communications skills.
  • Knowledge of military and Veteran populations.

Client Information

The National Artificial Intelligence Institute sits within the Digital Health Office of the Veterans Health Administration (VHA). Its mission is to improve the health and well-being of Veterans and to empower the VHA workforce by harnessing the potential of trustworthy AI solutions and emerging technologies. The Institute identifies and matures AI use cases, pursues and tests solutions for prioritized use cases, plans and conducts pilots, evaluates the effectiveness and value of those solutions, and supports enterprise adoption and scaling decisions. It also carries VHA’s responsibilities for federal AI transparency and oversight, working in collaboration with VA’s Chief AI Office. More information is available at

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

EEO Statement

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, parental status, veteran status, age, disability, or any other protected class. Veterans, members of the Reserve and National Guard, and transitioning active-duty service members are highly encouraged to apply.
