** This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients. This position is fully remote (indefinitely).**

Emergent Software is seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead the planning and delivery of custom software solutions for enterprise clients. You'll work closely with stakeholders, developers, architects, and executives to define product strategy, gather requirements, manage priorities, and guide projects from concept through delivery. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, a strong understanding of modern web application development, and a passion for solving complex business challenges through technology. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a client-facing consulting environment and enjoys bridging the gap between business goals and technical execution.

Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software

  • Work closely with other talented software engineers and analysts. Our vetting process means you can count on your team members to know what they are talking about.

  • Work from home or work remotely from anywhere you want

  • Flexible work schedule meaning you can work regular hours or whenever you work best

  • Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software. If you choose to work more than 40 hours, you’ll be compensated for the extra work!

  • Work on interesting projects solving complex business problems with custom software.

  • 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development. We invest in your growth!

  • Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful

  • Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave

Primary Duties

  • Partner with Clients

    • Establish a strategic roadmap, product vision and backlog.

    • Partner with clients to assist them in performing the Product Owner role.

    • Facilitate in-depth requirements gathering and analysis.

    • Document requirements as Features and User Stories to share with team.

    • Work with your team and client to create a plan for delivering on project objectives and achieving business value.

  • Partner with the Product Delivery Team

    • Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to colleagues in the Product Delivery Team.

    • Drive innovation and adoption of AI tooling in product development and delivery.

    • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and a community of practitioners.

    • Help craft future product offerings or client engagement options.

  • Partner with Sales

    • Lead product development activities for key/strategic client pursuits.

    • Present solution vision proposals to client executives.

    • Work with account executives on client satisfaction efforts in existing delivery engagements.

  • Partner with Technology Teams

    • Establish client technology roadmap.

    • Collaborate heavily with technology experts (architects and engineers) to vet requirements for technical feasibility.

    • Speak with intelligence on technology topics to clients to establish trust and confidence.

  • Partner with Delivery Teams

    • Execute on established plans.

    • Communicate technical and business requirements to delivery team.

    • Collaborate with senior delivery team members to solve complex challenges.

    • Demonstrate strong understanding of custom software development concepts and best practices in all interactions.

    • Ensure projects stay on target by regularly communicating status, risks, and change as they occur.

  • Be a Champion of the Agile Software Development Process

    • Work directly with clients to manage project delivery while encouraging and fostering an agile delivery method.

    • Apply agile concepts in real world settings, adapting principles to client’s level of agile sophistication and working to improve maturity over time.

    • Own backlog health and communicate deviation to expected value delivery proactively.

    • Act as a servant leader to your delivery team.

Required Qualifications

  • Product Ownership Experience

    • 7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager

    • Experience in delivering custom enterprise software solutions across a variety of technologies, platforms, and hosting paradigms.

    • Experience in crafting cost estimates to deliver components or entire projects.

    • Strong technical writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills are a must.

    • Experience operating as the liaison between agile development teams and users in defining requirements, performing business analysis, and driving delivery in the right direction.

  • Technology Knowledge

    • Experience utilizing AI tools in product development, product delivery, or project management.

    • A solid understanding of how websites, web applications, APIs, databases, and the cloud function at a high level.

    • Strong technical background enabling you to provide credible leadership to development teams and accurately evaluate complex project risks and issues.

  • Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach

    • Solid understanding of software development life cycle models including expert knowledge of Agile principles.

    • Experience with agile work organization tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, Rally).

    • A proven track record of successfully implementing custom web application projects using Agile methodologies.

  • Experience with Traditional Project Management Concepts

    • Experience with scope, schedule, budget, and risk management.

    • Must be viewed as a trusted source of truth by stakeholders through consistent, transparent, and confident communication.

    • Owns the narrative around project delivery, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and reassured throughout the lifecycle.

  • Occasional travel to client sites may be requested for activities such as annual planning meetings. Although travel is not expected to be frequent, the ability to accommodate occasional travel is required.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Strong preference towards candidates with experience delivering projects to client expectations, especially in a consulting capacity, software as a service environment, or delivering AI-accelerated (agentic) solutions.

  • Industry recognized Agile process certification (PMI-ACP, Scrum Alliance CSM or CSPO, Scrum.org PAL, SAFe, or equivalent).

  • Industry recognized Project management certification (PMP or equivalent).

  • Microsoft Azure technology certifications (AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900).

  • Experience on projects utilizing Microsoft stack technologies such as .NET, SQL Server, and Azure as well as JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, and Vue.js.

  • Some examples of profiles/backgrounds that we feel would do well in this role:

    • Scrum master turned product owner.

    • Independent consultant with previous experience on agile delivery teams (any role).

    • Someone who is a product owner with a passion for the technical side of software development.

Our Vetting Process

At Emergent Software, we work hard to find the best analysts capable of delivering high quality software for our clients. If you think you’re one of those, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us be successful in surrounding you with other top-notch people. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position:

  1. Application (5 minutes)

  2. Online Assessment (40-50 minutes)

  3. Initial Phone Interview & Technology Knowledge Assessment (45 minutes)

  4. Challenge Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Final Interview (60-90 minutes)

  6. Job Offer!

Benefits Package Details

  • Medical Insurance: up to 80% of your monthly medical premium (HSA options available)

  • HSA Contribution: up to $200/month

  • Dental & Vision Insurance: up to 50% of your monthly dental and vision premium costs

  • 401(k) plan: company match up to 4% of salary

  • Profit sharing bonus: up to 15% of salary paid quarterly

  • Extra compensation: get paid extra for work over 40 hours/week

  • Flex Spending Account (FSA) for Dependent Care & Healthcare Costs

  • Short Term Disability: $500/week for 12 weeks

  • Long Term Disability: up to $6,000/month

  • Group term life and AD&D insurance: $50k

  • PTO, standard holidays, 2 floating holidays

  • Paid parental leave: 2 weeks

  • Staff development program: 100 hours/year plus training costs

About Emergent Software

Emergent Software is a fast-growing software development, cloud consulting, and data engineering company serving clients across the country. We are regularly adding to our team of talented software engineers, cloud architects, data engineers, UX designers, technical product owners and more who can help us deliver high quality services for our clients.

We are a remote-first company

Since our inception, we've embraced a remote-friendly culture, promoting work flexibility beyond the norm. When the pandemic struck in 2020, our transition to fully remote work was seamless—just a matter of cleaning out the fridge. Recognizing an opportunity, we adopted a remote-first approach and began hiring talent from anywhere. We continue to offer our signature Minnesota-nice, Midwest-friendly attitude, ensuring everyone feels valued, whether or not they're familiar with the skyway system.

Your career grows with us

Working with talented engineers on interesting projects creates an engaging environment for software development enthusiasts. By working directly with our experienced team, participating in our staff development program, and solving complex problems across a variety of projects, you’ll find numerous opportunities for long-term career growth.

At Emergent Software, your ideas will be heard, you will grow exponentially as a master of your craft, and you will enjoy working other dedicated team members to deliver software solutions for our clients.

Check out what others say

Visit our Glassdoor page to discover how employees enjoy our remote working structure, flexible hours, profit sharing program, and more!

raw.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy¿Trabajas en una biblioteca, archivo o museo público, o preparas estas oposiciones?
raw.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Trabajas en una biblioteca, archivo o museo público, o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza.

📚 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos

Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos, en el que cada profesional aporte su experiencia en su ámbito y en su nivel.

No necesitas dominar todas las categorías. Puedes especializarte en Bibliotecas, Archivos o Museos, y en uno o varios niveles: Auxiliar, Ayudante o Facultativo/Conservador.

🗂️ Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores

⭐ Auxiliares (C1 / C2)

  • Auxiliar de Bibliotecas

  • Auxiliar de Archivos

  • Auxiliar de Museos

Se convocan sobre todo en comunidades autónomas, ayuntamientos, diputaciones y universidades, con denominaciones y grupo que varían según la administración.

⭐ Ayudantes (A2)

  • Ayudantes de Bibliotecas

  • Ayudantes de Archivos

  • Ayudantes de Museos

En el Estado, Cuerpo de Ayudantes de Archivos, Bibliotecas y Museos. En otras administraciones, escalas equivalentes con su propia denominación.

Facultativos y Conservadores (A1)

  • Facultativos de Bibliotecas

  • Facultativos de Archivos

  • Conservadores de Museos

En el Estado, Cuerpo Facultativo de Archiveros, Bibliotecarios y Arqueólogos y Cuerpo Facultativo de Conservadores de Museos. En otras administraciones, escalas superiores equivalentes.

🏛️ Una misma profesión, muchas convocatorias

Estas oposiciones las convocan administraciones muy distintas, y cada una tiene su denominación, su temario y su forma de examinar. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan procesos selectivos de:

  • Administración General del Estado / Ministerio de Cultura

  • Comunidades Autónomas

  • Ayuntamientos y otras entidades locales

  • Diputaciones

  • Universidades públicas

  • Otros organismos públicos

En las convocatorias autonómicas, locales y universitarias, la normativa y los sistemas de cada territorio o institución marcan la diferencia. Por eso queremos contar con preparadores de todas las comunidades autónomas.

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Profesionales con plaza (funcionarios/as o personal laboral fijo, en activo o en excedencia) en bibliotecas, archivos o museos públicos.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones.

  • Personas capaces de trabajar las dos caras de la oposición:

    • el contenido técnico de la profesión (biblioteconomía, archivística, museología, gestión de colecciones, normalización…),

    • y la legislación y el contenido específico de la administración que convoca, incluida la normativa autonómica cuando corresponda.

  • Quienes dominen las pruebas prácticas: catalogación y clasificación, descripción archivística, documentación de fondos museográficos…

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu ámbito, tu nivel y tu disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online del temario técnico y del temario específico de cada administración.

  • Supuestos prácticos: diseñarlos, resolverlos y corregir los de los alumnos.

  • Legislación de patrimonio, bibliotecas, archivos y museos, estatal y autonómica.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real.

  • Preparación de pruebas orales o de desarrollo, en los niveles superiores.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Temarios, esquemas, resúmenes y vídeos cortos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si tienes plaza, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu ámbito (bibliotecas, archivos o museos), tu nivel, en qué comunidad autónoma trabajas y qué administraciones conoces.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido del temario o la resolución de un supuesto práctico (por ejemplo, un ejercicio de catalogación o de descripción archivística), con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza en bibliotecas, archivos o museos y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte.

👉 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy.

Voici un poste à distance.

TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d'un(e) technicien spécialisé en informatique (bases de données et de développement) ayant d’excellentes aptitudes techniques, d’excellentes connaissances et qui souhaite mettre à profit ses compétences au sein d’une équipe polyvalente.

Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue.

Description des travaux ou des biens livrables :
  • Surveillance des infrastructures serveurs (mises à jour, redémarrage, espaces disques, etc.);
  • Surveillance du bon fonctionnement des interfaces;
  • Diagnostics et application de correctifs (filtres, ajustements, etc.);
  • Documente les échanges d’information entre les systèmes;
  • Mise en place d’interface selon les standards de l’organisation;
  • Participe à la mise en place de mécanismes d’échange (développement, certification, implantation, documentation et surveillance);
  • Contribue à l’extraction des données (contrôle de qualité, exploitation, indicateur de performance, etc.);
  • Contribue à la définition des structures de données organisationnelles (architecture);
  • Développe des outils pour l’automatisation des processus d’affaires;
  • Propose des mécanismes d’extraction automatisés pour faciliter le transfert d’information;
  • Propose des processus de certification et de contrôle de qualité basé sur la norme ISO17799;
  • Collabore à l’évaluation de la sécurité des micro-développements;
  • Propose des solutions automatisées pour garantir la sécurité dans le traitement des données (avant, pendant et après);
  • Élaborer et rédiger la documentation des environnements technologiques;
  • Contribue aux différentes étapes d’élaboration des projets;
​
  • Contribue à l’augmentation de la flexibilité d’intervention et à diminuer les délais lors des changements.

Profil

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales avec spécialisation en informatique d’une école reconnue OU Attestation d’études pertinentes dont l’équivalence est reconnue par l’autorité compétente;
  • Très bonne connaissance des outils bureautiques O365 de Microsoft dont Word, Excel, Visio et Powerpoint;
  • Bonnes connaissances en matière de sécurité informatique; Connaissance avancée du développement informatique d’application Web, Java, .Net, etc.;
  • Connaissance avancée des standards d’échange API REST, SOAP, XML, HL7, DICOM, etc.;
  • Connaissance réseau avancé pour faciliter le diagnostic des échanges;
  • Capacité de résolution de problèmes complexes.
  • Doit détenir un minimum de quatre (4) années d'expérience pertinente;
  • Certification Mirth Connect ou expérience de 4 ans d'utilisation confirmées d’un autre engin d’intégration
​
  • Certification en base de données Oracle et MSSQL ou expérience de 4 ans d'utilisation confirmées
LIEU DE TRAVAIL
Le lieu de travail sera déterminé selon le mandat, il peut être en télé travail ou chez le client.
POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?
TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l'excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l'échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l'excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.
Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connait une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.
Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergures.
TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.
Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l'équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.
Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.
AVANTAGES

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales

  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l'innovation

  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)

  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l'occasion d'événements familiaux

  • Outils informatiques adaptés

  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant

  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales

  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail

  • Cheminement de carrière

Technical Skills:

Work Style & Expectations:

raw.description:
ASoftExperté a empresa líder de mercado em soluções de software para a gestão integrada da conformidade, inovação e transformação digital de processos. E uma grande empresa possui grandes números: são mais de 900 colaboradores, mais de 3 mil clientes e 3 milhões de usuários, em mais de 50 países ao redor do mundo!

Completamos 31 anos e nosso sonho é atingir todos os países do globo com nossas soluções.

Por isso o nosso lema é#WeAreExpertsAndGlobal


A Oportunidade

A missão da pessoa Consultora em Automação de Processos é ser o motor comercial da oferta de BPA dentro da SoftExpert, gerando, qualificando e conduzindo oportunidades até a venda, com ênfase em prospecção ativa, já que BPA (diferente de outras ofertas) não tem um gatilho natural de demanda: o cliente sente a dor (planilhas, aprovações por e-mail, retrabalho, falta de controle de SLA), mas não parte espontaneamente para "comprar automação". Por isso, a atuação é centrada em traduzir dor de negócio em oportunidade comercial.

  • Prospecção ativa na carteira instalada de clientes (por exemplo, em áreas como RH, Financeiro e Jurídico, entre outras) e em contas novas;
  • Apoio ao time de Marketing com input de conteúdo comercial, como dores de cliente, casos de uso, argumentos de venda, para a construção de materiais de geração de demanda: e-mails, landing pages, webinars;
  • Abertura de portas dentro das contas, agendando conversas com decisores e áreas de negócio, não apenas com o contato técnico já existente;
  • Condução do discurso consultivo de venda (dor → automação → resultado), incluindo levantamento inicial de processo e volume junto ao cliente;
  • Repasse do escopo qualificado para o time técnico (Automation Builders) executar a automação;
  • Acompanhamento da oportunidade até o fechamento, garantindo continuidade do relacionamento comercial.
  • Conhecimento de processos de negócio e das principais dores operacionais de diferentes áreas (ex.: RH, Financeiro, Jurídico);
  • Conhecimento de práticas de BPM (Business Process Management) e de mapeamento de processos (ex.: notação BPMN), suficiente para conduzir com profundidade o levantamento inicial de processo e volume junto ao cliente e qualificar corretamente a oportunidade antes de repassá-la ao time técnico;
  • Vivência comercial com soluções de tecnologia, BPM, ERP ou correlatos;
  • Conhecer o portfólio SoftExpert (SE Suite) ou concorrentes.

Você irá se diferenciar se tiver:

  • Experiência prospectando soluções de automação de processos (ex.: Fluig/TOTVS, Pipefy, Sydle, Lecom ou similares);
  • Conhecimento do portfólio SoftExpert ou de soluções concorrentes;
  • Pós-graduação e/ou outras certificações em gestão de processos, gestão comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Get to Know the Security Services Team

We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end-to-end ownership, our team spans three core functions: Cloud Security Engineering, where we design hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, write Terraform baselines, and fix failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP; Penetration Testing, where we run disciplined offensive assessments across networks, apps, cloud, and AI/LLM systems to catch vulnerabilities before adversaries do; and Vulnerability Management, where we continuously prioritize, patch, and validate risk reduction across the client footprint. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption.

What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers and assessors are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. If you enjoy solving tough security problems and want to be part of a team that is scrappy enough to move fast but seasoned enough to get it right, you will be in good company here.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute, networking, storage, and IAM experience, to help clients design, implement, and maintain security controls that meet compliance and security requirements. This role is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in cloud security engineering, compliance frameworks, and cloud-based security best practices. You’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to strengthen their cloud security posture and automate security operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure environments.

What You'll Do

  • Deploy and maintain robust cloud security controls across AWS, GCP, Azure, and OCI to eliminate misconfigurations and preserve strict regulatory compliance alignment.
  • Execute deep-dive architectural risk assessments to surface cloud system vulnerabilities, evaluate asset exposures, and engineer targeted technical remediation blueprints.
  • Configure and manage enterprise security tool suites, including SIEM solutions, log analytics platforms, identity management layers, IDS/IPS tools, and vulnerability management engines.
  • Own the client relationship lifecycle as the primary trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio, establishing project milestones, managing communication pathways, and handling technical escalations with calm professionalism.
  • Programmatically enforce security controls by engineering automated, repeatable IaC deployment playbooks and security testing infrastructure.
  • Embed continuous security guardrails into CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments to intercept system vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle.
  • Investigate and contain cloud-related security incidents, rapidly executing forensic logic and remediation steps to restore system integrity and minimize blast radii.
  • Support continuous audit readiness within GRC platforms like Vanta by systematically gathering, testing, and validating cloud configuration evidence.

Who You Are

  • Proven multi-cloud security engineer - Command direct operational ownership of distributed cloud infrastructure security, with hands-on validation across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Cloud security architecture expert - Mastered advanced identity and access management (IAM) strategies, cloud network zoning, payload encryption standards, and systemic risk mitigation workflows.
  • Advanced security automation developer - Highly proficient in in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), building and deploying automated guardrails with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Python, and Bash.
  • GRC infrastructure strategist - Aligned technical, cloud-native configurations directly against global regulatory compliance and audit frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA.
  • Surgical technical problem-solver - Apply rigorous analytical diagnostics to isolate cloud infrastructure vulnerabilities, resolve failing controls, and execute zero-disruption remediation.
  • High-impact client consultant - Confidently orchestrate multiple client portfolios concurrently, partnering directly with US-based technology founders, DevOps leads, and executive teams to scale cloud security maturity.
  • Elite technical communicator - Deliver flawless written and verbal English communication that effortlessly translates dense cloud vulnerabilities and risk vectors into actionable business value.

What will help you succeed

  • Deep data and monitoring tooling execution - Advanced manipulation of enterprise logging platforms, vulnerability management engines, threat hunting feeds, and network traffic analysers.
  • Validated cloud security credentials - Hold active technical certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, or CISA.
  • Container and DevSecOps engineering - Practical success auditing and isolating security boundaries within microservice architectures, Docker instances, and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Zero Trust deployment models - Direct execution of identity-centric security policies, network micro-segmentation, and context-aware access structures.
  • Commercial tenure in fast-growth environments - Documented history scaling infrastructure configurations within hyper-growth tech startups or elite managed security service providers (MSSP).

What We Offer

  • Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
  • Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
  • Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
  • Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
  • A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
  • Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time (ET) to effectively support hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional teams. Occasional flexibility to adjust working hours is expected to accommodate changing business priorities, global collaboration, and time-sensitive hiring needs.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.

Hiring and Selection Process

  • Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with camera on (non-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law.
  • Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet’s operating principles.
  • Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step.

raw.description:
Location: Virginia Remote, United States of AmericaThales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Remote- Virginia, Maryland or District of Columbia

Thales is hiring an experience Sales Account Manager for our Identity & Biometrics Solutions (IBS) business is responsible for selling Thales solutions, protecting and growing the company’s strategic relationship with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and expanding its presence across federal law enforcement, border security, public safety, and digital identity markets.

The position manages assigned federal sales opportunities through the full sales lifecycle—from qualification and solution positioning through financial and commercial offer development, negotiation, order completion, and contract award. The Federal Account Executive serves as a primary sales interface for assigned accounts and is accountable for pipeline development, forecast accuracy, order intake, account growth, and customer satisfaction.

The role also identifies and shapes opportunities across DHS components and adjacent agencies responsible for national security, secure identity, border management, and public safety. Working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, advanced biometrics, and digital identity, the Federal Account Executive connects customer mission requirements with Thales solutions that support secure travel, fraud prevention, border security, identity assurance, and public safety.

In partnership with Solution Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, Capture, Finance, Contracts, Legal, and Bid Management, the position develops customer-specific value propositions, financial and commercial offers, and competitive pursuit strategies that convert qualified opportunities into orders and support sustainable business growth.

Key Area of Responsibility


Sales Execution and Account Growth

  • Own assigned federal sales opportunities throughout the sales lifecycle—from qualification and customer engagement through solution positioning, commercial offer development, negotiation, order completion, and contract award.
  • Serve as a primary sales interface for assigned DHS and federal accounts, building trusted relationships and maintaining a strong understanding of customer missions, priorities, purchasing requirements, and decision-making processes.
  • Promote and sell Thales’ portfolio of biometric, digital identity, identity proofing, credentialing, AI-enabled, border security, and public safety solutions, translating customer needs into differentiated operational, technical, and commercial value propositions.
  • Develop and execute sales and account plans that support order intake, revenue growth, margin objectives, account expansion, competitive displacement, and new customer acquisition.
  • Build and present financial and commercial offers in collaboration with Finance, Solution Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, Legal, and other stakeholders, including pricing and commercial terms that appropriately consider customer requirements, competition, delivery, risk, profitability, and delegated authority.
  • Lead or support customer negotiations involving pricing, scope, schedules, commercial terms, and change requests; address customer questions and objections; adapt offers as appropriate; and secure the internal approvals needed to advance opportunities toward closure.
  • Coordinate the commercial and administrative activities required to convert accepted offers into orders, contracts, contract modifications, or other recognized bookings, while maintaining accountability for opportunity status, customer commitments, internal actions, and closing plans.
  • Maintain customer satisfaction throughout the sales process; ensure accurate CRM, pipeline, and forecast information; and track performance against applicable sales indicators, including order intake, pipeline growth, forecast accuracy, revenue, and margin.

Opportunity Development, Capture, and Market Engagement

  • Protect and grow Thales’ strategic DHS portfolio by building relationships with executive decision-makers, acquisition officials, program leaders, CIO and CTO organizations, federal systems integrators, and strategic industry partners.
  • Identify, qualify, and shape adjacent opportunities across federal law enforcement, border security, public safety, digital identity, and other mission-critical government markets.
  • Apply customer intelligence, market analysis, and federal-industry knowledge to anticipate mission needs, influence requirements and acquisition strategies, and position Thales before solicitations are released.
  • Develop opportunity and capture plans addressing customer requirements, competitive positioning, win themes, solution gaps, teaming, pricing considerations, decision criteria, and overall pursuit strategy.
  • Lead complex, multi-million-dollar federal pursuits by coordinating cross-functional contributors, internal bid gates, opportunity reviews, and responses to RFIs, RFPs, and other federal procurement activities.
  • Prepare and coordinate required pursuit deliverables, including opportunity summaries, bid-gate materials, commercial strategies, executive summaries, compliant proposals, and closing plans.
  • Monitor and communicate relevant customer requirements, federal policy, funding priorities, acquisition strategies, technology trends, competitive activity, risks, and market opportunities to inform product roadmaps, innovation priorities, go-to-market plans, account strategies, and teaming approaches.

Minimum Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of successful enterprise sales, account management, business development, or capture experience supporting U.S. Federal Government customers, including meaningful responsibility for progressing opportunities toward orders or contract awards.
  • Demonstrated success selling mission-critical technology solutions, such as biometrics, digital identity, AI-enabled software, cybersecurity, border security, law enforcement, public safety, or identity management technologies.
  • Experience managing strategic federal accounts and delivering measurable sales growth through account expansion, opportunity conversion, competitive displacement, and new customer acquisition.
  • Demonstrated experience developing financial and commercial offers, positioning customer value, supporting pricing decisions, negotiating commercial terms, and completing the activities required to close sales.
  • Established relationships within DHS, federal law enforcement agencies, federal systems integrators, and/or relevant strategic industry partners.
  • Proven ability to identify, qualify, shape, manage, and win complex, multi-million-dollar federal opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of federal procurement processes, acquisition strategies, contract vehicles, competitive capture planning, and the federal acquisition lifecycle.
  • Experience leading or coordinating responses to RFIs, RFPs, and other federal procurement activities.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements, competitive information, financial considerations, and sales data to support opportunity and commercial decisions.
  • Strong customer communication, presentation, value-positioning, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts—including AI, biometrics, digital identity, cloud platforms, and enterprise software—to technical, acquisition, and executive audiences.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage opportunity progression, customer activity, pipeline development, sales forecasting, and closing plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and lead sales and pursuit activities through cross-functional influence rather than direct managerial authority.
  • Travel 20%

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

raw.description:
Semi-Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js)

Full-time contractor · Fully remote

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior backend developer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp. is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll join a healthcare project built in Node.js with Nest.js. You'll work with a wide range of code, libraries, and technologies, review other developers' code, and build the kind of adaptability that comes from switching between technologies rather than staying in one repository.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast. It also means we have no room for developers who can only prompt. You need to be able to read what the AI produced, know when it's wrong, and fix it yourself: solid fundamentals in JavaScript, Node.js, data structures, HTTP, and databases are the baseline, not a bonus. If you can't explain your code without the tool that wrote it, this isn't the role for you. Part of our technical interview is done without AI assistance.

You'll work directly with the client to architect solutions, and you'll be in direct contact with clients to discuss new features and present your progress. You'll learn to present ideas to clients in a professional, friendly way. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain backend applications in Node.js / Nest.js with clean, maintainable code
  • Implement and manage a serverless project using the Serverless Framework
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs and work with JSON data
  • Conduct code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement in the team
  • Write pull requests that include unit and integration tests
  • Collaborate with clients on features, updates, and technical guidance
  • Work independently while keeping the team and clients informed

We're looking for a self-starter who organizes their own day. We trust you to prioritize your week and keep everyone updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

  • Fluent Spanish
  • Advanced English (able to hold client conversations)

Technical

  • 2+ years of full-time JavaScript development
  • Solid backend experience in Node.js
  • Experience with Nest.js
  • Strong programming fundamentals: you can design, debug, and explain your code without AI assistance
  • Experience with the JavaScript ecosystem (Node, NPM)
  • Experience with the Serverless Framework
  • Experience with JSON and RESTful services
  • Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

  • Unit and integration testing
  • Fluent English (B2+)
  • Strong written and oral communication

What we offer

  • Fully remote: work from home or anywhere you choose
  • Competitive pay: rates that compete with the best in the Latin American market, tailored to your seniority and skills, paid in the currency you prefer
  • Crypto payment available on request
  • Full-time contractor: you manage your own finances
  • Flexible hours: we work across time zones and trust you to get your work done on your schedule
  • Company culture: no rigid hierarchy; hard work and enjoying the journey are not in conflict
  • Gaming: online games with colleagues over Discord is a regular thing here
  • Broad technical exposure: many technologies and challenges in a short time; you won't get bored in the same repositories
  • International clients: US, Canada, Germany, and beyond, with the languages and cultures that come with them
  • Professional development: sponsored online courses and certifications on demand
  • Career development: build expertise across industries, not only in code

Interested?

If this sounds like you and you meet the minimum requirements, apply.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The client is an award-winning Australian architecture and design practice with over 50 years of industry experience delivering innovative, sustainable, and people-focused design solutions. Headquartered in Sydney, the firm specializes in architecture, interior design, urban design, heritage conservation, and building diagnostics, serving clients across the residential, commercial, education, health, transport, and public sectors.

Renowned for its collaborative approach and technical expertise, Jackson Teece is committed to delivering high-quality projects that positively impact communities while meeting the highest standards of design, compliance, and project delivery.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are seeking an experienced Architect to join our team and support the delivery of active New South Wales projects, with a primary focus on technical documentation and project delivery rather than concept design. About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

About The Role

Accelerant is building a new platform that will serve as the backbone of how risk is exchanged in the future.The Product & Technology team is looking for a FullStack Software Engineer who is passionate about building high quality software systems that are valued by customers.

If you join our team, here are some of thingsyou’llbe doing:

  • Working closely withpeer engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
  • Developing new frontend and backend featuresthat help make our customers successful.
  • Writing backend code in Typescript that is fully unit tested.
  • Writing frontend code inSvelte,optimizingthe frontend codebase for speed, efficiency, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Moving fast,while taking the time to ship high-quality code.

What you bring to the table:

  • Experience building and scaling web applications.
  • Strong understanding of modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Strong coding ability.
  • Passionate problem-solving mindset.
  • Reputation for getting things done.
  • Strong sense of ownership.
  • Desire to learn and grow.

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience with Typescript.
  • Experience withSvelte, web components, or equivalent component model.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, and databases such as Postgres and Snowflake.
  • Experience with SQL-Like databases and data caching strategies such as Postgres, Snowflake, and Redis.
  • Experience integrating AI into the development lifecycle, including hands-on use of tools such as Cursor, Claude, and other LLM-based coding assistants to accelerate design, implementation, testing, and refactoring.
  • Experience building AI-enabled features and applications, including working with modern LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and developer tooling such as LangChain or equivalent frameworks.

A Kryptus é uma companhia brasileira de tecnologia, com filial na Suíça, contando com mais de 100 colaboradores, voltada à segurança da informação. Somos reconhecidos como Empresa Estratégica de Defesa, atuante em projetos críticos nacionais e internacionais, passando por um momento importante de expansão e crescimento de seus negócios.

Você é um especialista em Microsoft Sentinel, domina KQL e tem vivência em arquiteturas de segurança complexas? Quer ser a referência técnica de um ambiente corporativo crítico de uma das maiores empresas do Brasil?

Buscamos um Especialista/Arquiteto de SIEM dedicado para assumir a governança técnica, evolução e sustentação de uma arquitetura multi-workspace no Microsoft Sentinel. Você será o guardião da segregação de dados para auditorias de meios de pagamento (PCI-DSS), liderará a engenharia de detecção focada em fraudes e implementará fluxos avançados de automação (SOAR) e infraestrutura como código (IaC).

🏠Vaga HOME OFFICE

  • Arquitetura e Governança: Desenhar, manter e governar ambiente híbrido de Log Analytics Workspaces, garantindo isolamento hermético do ambiente PCI (Cartões) via RBAC granular.
  • Compliance (PCI-DSS/MOOZ): Traduzir requisitos de auditoria em casos de uso no Sentinel, criando relatórios automatizados (Workbooks) e garantindo retenção e imutabilidade de logs.
  • Automação (SOAR): Desenvolver e sustentar playbooks complexos no Azure Logic Apps, consumindo APIs para respostas autônomas (isolamento de máquinas, bloqueio de contas).
  • SIEM como Código (CI/CD): Versionar regras de detecção, playbooks e infraestrutura (IaC) integrados a ferramentas de esteira.
  • Threat Hunting: Liderar campanhas de caça a ameaças mensais utilizando consultas cruzadas (KQL avançado).
  • Engenharia de Dados e FinOps: Configurar conectores multivendor e otimizar custos de ingestão/retenção no Azure.

OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Nível superior completo em TI ou especialização compatível na área de Segurança da Informação;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura e administração de Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM/SOAR) e Azure Log Analytics;
  • Domínio avançado de KQL (Kusto Query Language) para regras complexas e cross-workspace;
  • Conhecimento prático de compliance PCI-DSS aplicado ao monitoramento de segurança;
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) e fluxos de automação avançada (consumo de APIs e orquestração).

DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Certificações oficiais Microsoft Security (Ex: SC-200 ou SC-100);
  • Proficiência em mapeamento tático via MITRE ATT&CK voltado ao setor financeiro/adquirência;
  • Conhecimentos práticos do modelo de normalização ASIM da Microsoft;
  • Experiência com práticas de FinOps para otimização de custos em nuvem.

raw.description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary:

As a Foundant Support Consultant, EMEA, you are a trusted advisor and problem solver for Foundant clients across the EMEA market. You'll be the first Foundant support team member based in the region, filling the last gap in our global Monday–Friday support coverage for both GivingData and GLM/SLM. As part of the global Client Support team, you'll partner with colleagues in the US and Australia during time zone overlap to ensure clients always have dependable, fast-moving, expert help available. Overall, the role of Support Consultant encompasses client relationship building, creative technical problem-solving, and internal team support, all aimed at providing exceptional service to clients and fostering a collaborative and successful work environment within the team.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • Directly support the successful resolution of client tickets that come through Foundant's Support channels: chat, phone, and email.
  • Develop and maintain a high degree of product knowledge across both GivingData and GLM/SLM, ramping on GivingData first before cross-training into GLM/SLM.
  • Support the implementation of new GivingData, GLM/SLM clients as needed, in addition to ongoing support responsiblities, ensuring a smooth transition from onboarding into day-to-day support.
  • Handle frontline support tickets that are in Service Level Agreement breach.
  • Collaborate with and assist other members of the global Support team, including regular partnership with US and Australia-based colleagues during timezone overlap.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Strategize and problem solve with team members to ensure that clients have the best possible experience.
  • Monitor and assist in the triage of frontline support tickets, ensuring that clients get connected to the resource that best suits their needs.
  • As directed, provide internal and external training on selected Foundant software products and their features/functions.
  • Conduct and facilitate warm handoffs when needed to ensure the client has the right resource to match their needs.
  • Documentation and note taking for relevant client interactions.
  • Following up on tasks and projects arising from client interactions.
  • Enabler in cross-team and cross-department communication with leadership and other team members.
  • Collaborate with the Escalations team to resolve and advise on complex technical issues.
  • Contribute to and lead continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Client Experience.
  • Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 3-5 years of experience in support or implementation roles specifically (general customer service experience alone is not sufficient).
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred.
  • Direct experience in the philanthropic sector (grant making, scholarship administration, fund accounting, donor relations) is a strong differentiator, though not required.
  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software, experience with Zendesk preferred.
  • Familiarity with Agile Project Management software tools such as Confluence and Jira preferred.
  • Legally eligible to work in Ireland or the UK.
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

Adaptive Achievement

  • Keen attention to detail for accuracy, delivering on internal and external requirements with a time-sensitive approach.
  • Strong time management skills to juggle multiple, concurrent tasks and deadlines with ease.

Productive Collaboration

  • Comfort working as part of a distributed, global team - partnering regularly with US and Australia-based colleagues during time zone overlap.
  • Strong client relationship-building skills alongside standard technical support experience.

Service Orientation

  • An exceptional, client satisfaction-driven approach to every interaction.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, adaptable across different client audiences.

Business Insight

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn software programs and analyze data.
  • Comfort ramping across multiple products (GivingData, then GLM/SLM), building a working knowledge of how each supports clients' philanthropic missions.

Active Learning

  • A growth mindset and openness to cross-training into new product areas as the role and region develop.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Site Activation Leader (Study Start-Up Lead, Site Start-Up Lead) to join our team working remotely.

As a Site Activation Leader, you will provide expert planning and functional oversight for clinical trial programs and individual studies, driving operational excellence and the on-time, high-quality initiation of clinical research sites. You will lead site activation activities from feasibility through activation, coordinate the study critical path, and help enable efficient study conduct and enrollment across multiple studies and therapeutic areas.

You will join a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where your leadership will connect project management, site start-up teams, clinical operations, clients, and investigative sites. Through strategic planning, cross-functional coordination, process optimization, and quality oversight, you will strengthen site activation delivery and contribute directly to the successful execution of clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead site activation planning and strategy development for assigned clinical studies, overseeing milestones and deliverables from site feasibility through last site activation.
  • Develop, coordinate, and execute the study critical path plan, including site feasibility, site selection, Regulatory Green Light, site initiation, site activation, system setup, Trial Master File and Expected Document List management, ethics committee and regulatory authority or Ministry of Health strategy, informed consent form customization, risk mitigation, activation requirements, tools, documents, and reporting.
  • Monitor and report site activation progress across multiple studies, identify potential delays and risks, and lead cross-functional teams in resolving complex activation challenges.
  • Provide guidance to site activation team members and serve as a liaison among project management, site start-up teams, site activation functions, and clinical operations leadership.
  • Manage client relationships and communications regarding site activation timelines and deliverables, and serve as the Study Start-Up Subject Matter Expert for designated client accounts.
  • Provide strategic guidance, best practice recommendations, and technical expertise to support optimal study initiation and site activation outcomes.
  • Support business development activities by contributing site activation expertise to proposals and bid pursuit meetings.
  • Implement standardized site activation processes and best practices, analyze activation metrics, and drive process optimization and quality initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures, and contribute to the development and maintenance of site activation procedures and templates.
  • Lead the use of Clinical Trial Management System, Electronic Data Capture, Interactive Response Technology, and Trial Master File systems to optimize site activation workflows.
  • Oversee accurate documentation, data integrity, system maintenance, timeline planning, and resource allocation across the assigned portfolio.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in site activation leadership, strategic planning, and cross-functional coordination
  • Comprehensive knowledge of clinical trial regulations, Good Clinical Practice, site activation processes, and clinical research operations
  • Advanced project management, critical thinking, problem-solving, and process improvement capabilities
  • The ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, clients, investigative sites, and cross-functional teams
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in complex clinical trial documentation

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 4-7 years of experience in clinical research operations with site activation leadership
  • Proven experience leading site activation teams and processes
  • Comprehensive knowledge of clinical trial start-up processes and requirements
  • Strong background in regulatory compliance in clinical research
  • Extensive experience working with clinical research sites and investigators
  • Demonstrated understanding of clinical trial timelines and milestone management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with senior stakeholders

Benefits and Compensation

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match
  • Pet Insurance

For a complete list of benefits, please visit .

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes paid time off, a 401(k) match, life insurance, health insurance, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

EEO Disclaimer

raw.excerpt: Curewiki operates a patient-initiated clinical research discovery platform live across Europe.
raw.description:
Curewiki operates a patient-initiated clinical research discovery platform live across Europe. Patients find and self-pre-screen for research opportunities themselves, and patient organisations are the backbone of the trust that makes that possible. Belgium, France, and the Netherlands are our home markets: the network is real, the commercial opportunities on top of it (panels, surveys, advisory boards) are growing, and the market now needs a dedicated owner.

We're looking for a mission-driven and autonomous Patient Engagement Manager to own the Belgian and Dutch patient organisation network. Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you'll put patients at the center of Curewiki's growth in Belgium, France, and the Netherlands: from outreach and co-creation of content to activating patient organisations behind commercial opportunities. You'll grow and maintain the partner network in your markets, develop trusted collaborations, and make sure the patient-initiated framing holds in everything we do.

Your responsibilities:

Patient organisation partnerships & relationship management

  • Lead outreach and relationship-building with patient associations across conditions in BeNeFra
  • Build new relationships with patient organisations aligned to Curewiki's target conditions, continuously growing the partnership pipeline
  • Maintain and deepen relationships with organisations already in the network: regular contact, platform training, and involvement in new product developments and opportunities
  • Build capacity within patient organisations so they can engage confidently and sustainably over the long term

Commercial opportunity support

  • When commercial opportunities arise in BeNeFra (panels, surveys, advisory boards), own the patient engagement strategy for that opportunity
  • Contact and mobilise the relevant patient organisations to support the opportunity
  • Manage and nurture the opportunity through to delivery, in close coordination with Customer Success

Organic growth & patient marketing

  • Develop campaigns with patient orgs (newsletters, webinars, social media) to attract, inform, and retain patients on the Curewiki platform in Dutch and French, using AI tools to produce more without losing the human tone patients trust
  • Write and adapt clear, accessible content for community channels, in partnership with internal teams
  • Help maintain consistent messaging across touchpoints to protect patient trust

Requirements

  • You've built a community, advocacy network, or partnership portfolio and can show it: organisations you brought in, kept engaged, and turned into active collaborators
  • Native or near-native French, fluent English, and professional Dutch — your writing earns trust
  • You work independently: you run your own outreach pipeline, close collaborations, and ask for coaching rather than instructions
  • You use AI tools naturally in your daily work and know when patient-facing content needs a fully human hand
  • Deep empathy for patient communities; a personal connection to patient advocacy or healthcare is a strong plus

Nice to have

  • Experience in email marketing, community management, or patient-facing awareness campaigns
  • Comfortable with digital content creation (social media posts, short video)
  • Familiarity with the Belgian, French, and Dutch healthcare and patient advocacy landscape

Benefits

  • Real ownership from day one: the BeNeFra patient organisation network is yours to grow.
  • A genuine mission-driven role: your work puts patients at the center of how clinical research becomes accessible
  • Remote work within Belgium or France
  • A fast, transparent hiring process: intro call, hiring-manager deep-dive, practical working session, founder conversation, references — feedback at every step, completed in weeks not months
  • A high-velocity, mission-driven team that writes things down, moves fast, and takes AI leverage as a baseline in every role
  • Autonomy paired with support: you run your own pipeline and ask for coaching rather than instructions, backed by the Head of Partnerships and the wider commercial team

raw.title: Kotlin/Java Developer (Integration)
raw.excerpt: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users.
raw.description:
Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users. The system involves storing user payment data and is subject to PCI DSS compliance. It contains multiple integrations with payment systems, providers, and other gateways and processors, including 3DS.

Job Responsibilities

  • Developing new payment integrations and services;

  • Automating and optimizing integration processes;

  • Analyzing external provider documentation, conducting rapid checks, and defining epics and tasks based on Proof of Concept;

  • Participating in the design and development of high-load system architectures;

  • Supporting and improving existing solutions and services;

  • Writing high-quality, test-covered code (unit tests, integration tests);

  • Conducting code reviews;

  • Optimizing system performance and database queries;

  • Analyzing and resolving production incidents and bugs;

  • Processing and resolving requests from technical support and users as part of daily duties;

  • Collaborating with the QA team to ensure the high quality of delivered products;

  • Using AI-tools to accelerate delivery of integration modules and creating internal tools to generate integration code from business requirements;

  • Maintaining technical documentation and writing technical specifications;

  • Assisting in onboarding new developers and ensuring code quality;

  • Definition and formation of technical epics — analyzing existing solutions, identifying opportunities to improve system architecture, performance, and reliability, preparing improvement proposals, and aligning them with the team lead and architect;

  • Participation in the creation of business epics — analyzing requirements, assessing feasibility, and proposing alternative or optimized solutions based on technical expertise; collaborating with analysts and product managers to determine the best implementation approach;

  • Preparing tasks based on approved epics, ensuring proper detailing and alignment with architectural and business requirements;

  • Estimating task completion timelines, participating in sprint planning, and providing accurate technical time and effort estimates.

Requirements

You’ll thrive here if you have

  • 3+ years of commercial development experience with Kotlin (Java will be a plus);

  • Experience working with the Spring Framework;

  • Experience developing and integrating payment solutions (billing, payment gateways, and payment processors);

  • Practical experience integrating with external payment providers;

  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases (MySQL);

  • Experience with NoSQL databases (Redis);

  • Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Codeium, etc.) to improve speed and quality of development;

  • Ability to critically review AI-generated code, ensuring production-ready quality and compliance with company standards;

  • Knowledge of Event-Driven Architecture principles and experience with distributed messaging systems (e.g., Apache Kafka);

  • Excellent command of core software development and design principles, test-driven development (TDD), and CI/CD processes;

  • Solid understanding of microservice architecture;

  • English proficiency level B1 or higher.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Camunda (creating and supporting processes);

  • Solid understanding of PCI DSS standards, ISO 27001, and other information security methodologies;

  • Practical experience working with AWS;

  • Experience with Jira and GitLab CI/CD;

  • Experience in designing or developing internal tools that automate or accelerate integration development (e.g., generators based on business requirements).

Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.

  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.

  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.

  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.

  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.

  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.

  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Recruitment process

  1. HR interview (40 min);

  2. Interview with hiring managers (1,5 hour);

  3. Test task;

  4. Final interview (1 hour) optional;

  5. Recommendations check;

  6. Offer.
