title: Middle+ QA Engineer
description: At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit.

raw.title: Middle+ QA Engineer
raw.excerpt: At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit.
raw.description:
At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit.
We are the first interest-free and no-annual-fee credit card in Mexico, designed to simplify personal finances and give users complete control – all from a mobile app. With NOVACARD, users can access up to $200,000 MXN in credit, only pay when they use it, and manage everything digitally in under 5 minutes. Our mission is to empower people to make smarter financial decisions by offering flexibility, transparency, and the freedom they need to reach their goals. Simple finances, big goals.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and seamless operation of our mobile and backend products. You will work across the full product flow — from a user action in the Android or iOS app through APIs, message queues, and databases — helping the team deliver secure and stable financial services to our customers.

This role is ideal for an experienced QA professional who enjoys investigating complex systems, identifying risks before release, and collaborating closely with product, development, analytics, and QA teams in a fast-paced fintech environment.

The role is fully remote, with occasional business trips if required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze new functionality, create test designs, and write and maintain test cases.

  • Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.

  • Test NOVACARD’s mobile applications on Android and iOS, including behavior across OS versions, screen resolutions, application updates, push notifications, and deeplinks.

  • Validate complete user scenarios across the application, APIs, message queues, and databases — from user action to final data state.

  • Prepare and maintain test data, including customers at different lifecycle stages, tariffs, credit limits, and product offers.

  • Analyze test results, identify defects and risks, and provide clear, timely testing reports.

  • Review requirements, identify cross-team dependencies, and align them with relevant teams before testing begins.

  • Estimate testing effort, contribute to the maintenance and expansion of the regression test suite, and support release planning.

  • Investigate logs, trace requests across services using correlation or trace IDs, and collaborate with developers to diagnose complex issues.

  • Continuously improve QA processes, testing coverage, and product quality together with engineering and QA teams.

Requirements

Key Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience testing complex software systems.

  • 2+ years of experience testing external integrations.

  • Strong experience in functional testing of mobile applications for Android and iOS.

  • Hands-on experience working with device logs, including Android Logcat and iOS Console.

  • Experience intercepting and analyzing mobile traffic, as well as testing application behavior across different operating-system versions and screen resolutions.

  • Strong understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.

  • Excellent knowledge of software testing theory and test-design techniques.

  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, and test-management tools such as X-Ray, TestRail, Test IT, Zephyr, or similar platforms.

  • Strong understanding of SOAP and REST API testing, including XML and JSON, response codes, contract schemas, session-based and token-based authentication.

  • Confident SQL skills: ability to independently write medium-complexity queries using joins and aggregations, read database schemas, and validate data after product operations in MS SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication between services, including Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar message brokers; consumers, idempotency, retries, and delayed effects.

  • Experience with logging and monitoring systems such as Kibana, OpenSearch, Grafana, or similar tools.

  • Experience testing products built on a microservices architecture, including understanding service boundaries and the impact of changes on dependent services.

  • Ability to independently prepare test data using SQL scripts, internal/service APIs, and emulation of external-system states.

  • Fluent Russian and English at B1+ level, sufficient for working with technical documentation and an international team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Charles, Fiddler, Swagger, Postman, or SOAP UI.

  • Experience in fintech or banking products, particularly card processing, credit products, tariffs, fees, limits, card statuses, and card lifecycle management.

  • Basic API test automation in Postman and experience running collections through Newman.

  • Experience testing BPMS processes and workflow engines such as Camunda.

  • Experience working with Git and CI/CD tools, including GitLab CI or Jenkins; ability to review build logs and independently run pipelines for test environments.

  • Understanding of security requirements for financial applications, including personal-data handling, OTP flows, sessions, and basic PCI DSS principles.

  • Experience estimating testing tasks and working with QA quality metrics, such as defect detection effectiveness (DDE), defect density, and test coverage.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work format.

  • Official employment in accordance with the Russian Labor Code for residents of Russia; contractor collaboration for candidates from other countries.

  • Opportunity to work in an international team on an innovative digital credit product for the Mexican market.

  • A product-focused, data-driven environment where quality directly influences the financial experience of thousands of users.

  • The chance to work on complex mobile, backend, and integration scenarios in a rapidly growing fintech company.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreNEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement.
raw.description:
Who We Are

NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world's most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm — 220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

Trading Operations & Execution Oversight

  • Advise on the end-to-end futures trading operations stack across multiple platforms and different asset classes.

  • Advice to oversee aggregate trader activity across futures platforms to understand how the trader population behaves, sim farming detection, how profitable vs unprofitable cohorts operate, and where risk concentrates

  • Advise on pattern analysis, odd-trade detection, and gamification reviews to identify behaviour inconsistent with legitimate trading and share what action is recommended.

  • Translate complex findings into clear recommendations that inform rule design and risk posture.

  • Advice on managing emerging risk patterns before they materialise as losses.

  • Help the team create risk scoring frameworks and trader profiles to help department for the broader terms.

  • Advise on A-book / B-book routing logic, internalisation strategy, and the conditions under which trader flow is hedged externally.

Risk Framework Design & Margin Oversight

  • Propose the architecture of the abuse detection framework, risk parameters, and behavioural constraints that govern the trader population

  • Set and review limits at instrument, asset class, client tier, and book level; advise on stress testing and scenario analysis.

  • Act as the subject-matter expert for trading and risk infrastructure, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and operational resilience under stress.

  • Recommend trader-profile taxonomies that segment the population by strategy, behaviour, and risk contribution.

  • Design and supervise risk frameworks covering market exposure, liquidity, basis, and execution risk on the futures book.

  • Guide A-book vs. internalisation framework decisions based on cohort behaviour, P&L distribution, and risk concentration — informed by industry practice.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

  • 8+ years in trading, execution, or risk roles within listed derivatives, with deep expertise in at least two of: equity index futures, rates futures, FX futures, energy futures, or metals futures.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the funded-trader / prop firm model — either inside a futures prop firm or advising one. You understand how this business actually makes and loses money, and where traders find edge against the house.

  • Working knowledge of the major players in the futures prop space and a clear view of what each has done well or poorly on risk and rule design.

  • Working knowledge of regulated entities under NFA, CFTC, and/or CME Group.

  • Sharp judgement on trader-behaviour patterns: sim farming, account cycling, hedging exploits, gap arbitrage, news abuse, micro-scalping concentration.

  • Strong written communication — you can turn complex risk findings into recommendations a CEO and a Head of Trading can act on quickly.

Your X-Factor

  • Combines market intuition with engineering rigor — designing trading systems that balance speed, control, and resilience.

  • Speaks the language of both markets and code, bridging traders, quants, engineers, and risk teams with equal fluency.

  • Thrives in complexity — bringing structure and clarity to fast-moving, multi-jurisdictional trading environments.

  • Champions a culture of operational excellence rooted in transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Your Journey After Applying

  • 30-minute HR Session with the Talent Acquisition team

  • 60-minute Session with the Top Management

Why Join NEXT

At NEXT Ventures, performance is more than numbers — it's the pulse that drives innovation and impact. Join us to architect a world-class trading and risk ecosystem that powers performance-based capital across continents. Be part of the team that turns market opportunity into operational excellence and ambition into measurable results.

Your next chapter in global trading leadership begins here.

業務内容
  • 当社が管理する全施設の予約業務全般の管理
  • 予約の受付・作成・管理および確認書の送付
  • ゲスト、代理店、パートナー、国内外OTAからの問い合わせ対応
  • 国内OTAの料金、プラン、施設情報の管理
  • 国内外OTAに掲載される情報の最新かつ正確な維持管理
  • 国内外OTAとの連携およびコーディネート業務のサポート
  • 国内予約に関するエスカレーションおよびクレーム対応
  • 予約マネージャーの指示に基づく国際予約業務のサポート
  • 週次売上目標達成に向けた取り組みおよび実績管理
  • 夏季・冬季の料金プランおよび売上目標を踏まえた業務対応
  • 顧客データベースの管理
  • リゾート内イベント、アクティビティ、営業時間、食事オプション等の情報管理
  • ゲストサービス（アクティビティ等）に関する情報管理
  • 必要に応じてフロント、セールス、マーケティング等、他部署のサポート
【変更の範囲：会社の定める業務・就業場所】
※試用期間終了後、約２週間～１か月間、ニセコ・ルスツ・富良野現地にて実務研修を実施予定。
雇用形態: 1年間の有期雇用契約
試用期間: ３か月
契約更新有無: 可能性有
​
契約更新の理由:
  • 従業員の勤務成績および勤務態度
  • ​会社の業務上の必要性、経営状況等
正社員雇用制度：有
就業場所: リモートワーク
再雇用制度: あり（65歳まで）
勤務時間: シフト制（9時間拘束のうち１時間休憩、週５日制、状況により繁忙期には週６日の可能性もあり）
  • 09:00~18:00

受動喫煙対策: 在宅勤務のため対象外
昇給: あり（業績による）
残業：あり（平均時間：月10時間）
３６協定：あり（季節的要因等による受注・一般顧客の集中による業務の多忙）
休日：週休２日制
その他休業・休暇
  • 年次有給休暇（入社6か月後、10日付与）
  • 慶弔休暇（別途規定有）
  • 私傷病休暇（年間５日付与）
  • 産前産後・育児休業（男性取得実績有）

Requirements

必要条件

  • 中級以上の英語力（英検２級又はTOEIC600点以上）必須
  • ホテル又は旅行業界の経験2年以上必須​
  • 中級程度のPCスキル必須
  • 留学経験があれば尚可
  • 丁寧で正確な電話応対ができ、細かい点にも注意を払える方
  • 円滑なコミュニケーション能力と基本的な時間管理能力をお持ちの方
  • 前向きに業務へ取り組み、課題に対して主体的に対応できる方
  • 会社の方針や業務手順、システムを理解し、適切に遵守できる方
  • チームワークを大切にしながら、自主性を持って行動できる方
  • 業務が集中する場面でも、複数の業務を整理しながら責任を持って対応できる方
  • ゲスト一人ひとりに寄り添ったサービスを提供し、思い出に残る滞在体験づくりに意欲を持てる方
リモートワーク必須条件
  • 日本国内に居住し、日本で就労可能な方
  • 試用期間終了後、約２週間～１か月間、ニセコ・ルスツ・富良野現地にて、通常業務を行いながら、プロパティ見学やフロント業務などを通じて実務研修を行います
  • 勤務は従業員の自宅からのフルリモート勤務とします（情報セキュリティ及び個人情報保護の観点から、カフェ・コワーキングスペース・旅行先等での勤務は認めていません）
  • 安定したインターネット回線および静かな作業スペースを確保でき、家族や第三者にゲストの個人情報が見聞きされない環境で勤務できる方
  • 勤務時間中は、業務連携や進捗確認のため、ミーティングやトレーニング等必要に応じてWebカメラをオンにして頂く場合があります
  • 会社の指示により、必要に応じて現地出張を求める場合があります

Benefits

年俸パッケージ・福利厚生

310万円～360万円
パッケージに含まれるもの：
  • リクレーション手当有（別途規定有）
  • 雇用保険、労災、健康保険、厚生年金 の加入可能
  • 社員旅行（業績による）
  • 社内イベント
  • ボーナス制度（決算賞与）

raw.description:
Note: This is for active pooling purposes only. Submitting your application does not guarantee employment. Your details will be kept on file and considered for future opportunities as they become available.

We are seeking a proactive and experienced IT Manager to lead our internal IT operations while supporting managed services for our clients. This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical background across IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and the Microsoft ecosystem, combined with a hands-on approach to managing day-to-day IT operations. You will be responsible for maintaining secure and reliable systems, implementing and managing cybersecurity best practices aligned with ISO 27001, and administering Microsoft's security and compliance solutions, including Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Copilot, and the Microsoft Security Stack (e.g., Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune). In addition to overseeing internal IT, you will also provide technical guidance and escalation support for managed service and help desk operations, ensuring clients receive high-quality IT support and exceptional service.

Position: IT Manager

Salary: PHP45,000 - PHP95,000/month (depending on experience and technical skills)

Working Hours & Conditions: AU/NZ business hours; full-time (remote)

Holidays: TBD

Responsibilities:

      • Oversee and manage the organization's internal IT infrastructure, systems, and day-to-day operations.
      • Implement, maintain, and improve cybersecurity policies, controls, and best practices aligned with the ISO 27001 framework.
      • Administer and support the Microsoft security ecosystem, including Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune.
      • Monitor system performance, security, and compliance, proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
      • Manage Microsoft 365 administration, user accounts, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
      • Provide technical leadership and escalation support for managed services and help desk operations, ensuring timely resolution of client and internal IT issues.
      • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and clients to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable IT solutions.
      • Develop and maintain IT documentation, security procedures, disaster recovery plans, and operational processes.
      • Evaluate, recommend, and implement new technologies to improve business efficiency and strengthen security.
      • Ensure IT systems remain compliant with organizational security standards and industry best practices.

Requirements

Qualifications:

      • 2 to 4+ years of experience as an IT Manager, Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or in a similar senior IT role.
      • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, particularly ISO 27001, including governance, risk management, and compliance.
      • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview for data governance, compliance, and information protection.
      • Experience using Microsoft Copilot and integrating AI-driven productivity tools within Microsoft 365 environments.
      • Strong expertise across the Microsoft Security Stack, including Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft 365 Security.
      • Experience administering Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, Active Directory, networking, and endpoint management.
      • Experience supporting managed services (MSP) environments or providing help desk/service desk leadership is highly preferred.
      • Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
      • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
      • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified, Azure, Security, or Cybersecurity certifications) are highly desirable.

Benefits

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience and skill set
  • 100% remote role — work from home anywhere in SA
  • Paid local holidays aligned with the AU/NZ business calendar
  • Opportunities for training and professional growth
  • Work directly with a supportive AU/NZ team — no agency middleman
  • Long-term engagement with a stable and growing business

Position Title

Director - Small Business Banking Sales

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Director-Small Business Banking Sales is responsible for the direct management and coaching a team of 10-20 phone based Small Business Banking Consultants and Relationship Specialists support staff across multiple geographic locations via a phone-based model, which focuses on new business development, credit quality, and risk management. The focus is generally within our current footprint on commercial based customers with revenues from six figures to multi-millions of dollars, and loan sizes up to $5mm. Partners with and supports Consumer Banking Leadership to capitalize on and leverage the Retail Branch Platform and referrals, and external Centers of Influence and contacts, to expand the lending and deposit opportunities. The Director-Small Business Banking Sales is instrumental in working with key partners to help buildout and enhance business optimization and efficiency along with credit automation tools resulting in quick and effective outcomes. Provides input to pricing and market competitiveness based on experience and market research. Oversees/manages audit, compliance, and regulatory matters for the department. Ensures the generation of revenue by cultivating Small Business account relationships and ensuring strong credit quality thresholds are met

Job Responsibilities:

JOBRESPONSIBILITIES

This is a remote position.

Role Title:Senior QA Engineer (Manual + Automation)
Employment Status:Full-Time Contractual
Engagement:Initial 6-month contract (with potential to extend with the right fit)
Work Roster:9AM-5PM Brisbane Time
Location:Remote

Role Summary
We are looking for aSenior QA Engineerwith strong hands-on experience across bothManual and Automated Testingto help ensure the quality and reliability of web and SaaS products.
You will be involved throughout the SDLC, covering test planning, functional and regression testing, API validation, automation, accessibility, cross-browser/device testing, and defect management.
The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and confident communicating QA findings and testing approaches with developers, stakeholders, and other QA team members.

Key Responsibilities
Test Planning & Manual Testing
  • Review requirements, user stories, and designs to understand testing requirements.
  • Create test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through to resolution.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum sprints and QA planning.
  • Clearly communicate testing findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
API & Data Testing
  • Test REST APIs and webhooks using tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
  • Test complex workflows including authentication, checkout, search, dashboards, and CMS functionality.
  • Validate data, content updates, and database changes.
  • Test edge cases, error handling, and integration scenarios.
  • Conduct regression testing before releases.
Automation Testing
  • Create, maintain, and execute automated UI and API tests.
  • Build reusable automated regression tests for critical workflows.
  • Apply automation where it provides meaningful testing value.
  • Work with developers to support testing within CI/CD workflows.
  • Use automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, or Vitest.
Cross-Platform & Accessibility Testing
  • Test responsive web applications across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge.
  • Test across desktop, tablet, iOS, and Android devices.
  • Perform accessibility checks including keyboard navigation, screen readers, and colour contrast.
  • Identify UI, UX, performance, and visual issues.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional QA experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Manual Testing and test case management.
  • Solid understanding of Automated Testing and automation frameworks.
  • Strong experience in functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and API testing.
  • Practical experience withPostman, Insomnia, or similar API testing tools.
  • Experience withPlaywright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, or Vitest.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams and tools such as Jira, Trello, or GitHub.
  • Good understanding of web applications, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript behaviour.
  • Experience testing across browsers and multiple devices.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain testing decisions, findings, and technical issues.

Nice to Have
  • Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, or Headless CMS.
  • Knowledge of WCAG and accessibility testing.
  • Basic SQL/database knowledge.
  • Experience with CI/CD and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience working with e-commerce or SaaS products.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other QA team members.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Critical and high-priority bugs are identified before reaching production.
  • Testing is completed within agreed sprint and release timelines.
  • Test documentation remains clear, accurate, and reliable.
  • Automated test coverage is improved for critical workflows where appropriate.
  • Production issues are reduced through effective manual and automated regression testing.
  • Bugs are reported clearly with accurate steps to reproduce and supporting information.
  • QA findings and risks are communicated clearly to the wider team.

Job Description:

The Sr. Manager - Business Development will be a key member of Nextpower’s Robotics and Services Business Development team, responsible for driving the commercial strategy and market expansion of Nextpower’s robotic solar inspection systems and AI-powered fire/smoke detection camera systems for large-scale solar assets. This role centers on delivering sales growth, managing strategic customer relationships, and advancing Nextpower’s leadership position within the utility-scale solar market through innovative, technology-driven service offerings.

The ideal candidate combines deep solar industry expertise, a strong professional network among Independent Power Producers (IPPs), EPCs, and O&M providers, and a proven record of exceeding revenue targets in a competitive renewable energy landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Development

    • Drive new business opportunities for Nextpower's robotics and services business across North America.

    • Lead all aspects of sales cycle, from prospecting through contract negotiation and closure.

    • Develop and execute strategic account plans to maximize revenue growth and market share.

    • Collaborate with Nextpower's global account management team to identify value-add opportunities through robotics and services solutions.

  • Customer Engagement & Relationship Management

    • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with IPPs, EPCs, and O&M providers within the utility-scale solar segment.

    • Represent Nextpower at conferences/industry events to drive awareness, value proposition and benefits of robotics and services solutions.

    • Maintain a deep understanding of customer challenges and goals; drive value-added solutions utilizing Nextpower's robotics and services capabilities.

  • Team Collaboration

    • Work closely with Nextpower regional sales, marketing, and project management teams to drive training and knowledge sharing of robotics and services solutions.

    • Collaborate with HQ and global regional Nextpower functions to: (1) quantify product value proposition; (2) prepare localized sales and marketing collateral; (3) facilitate and manage the delivery of technical support to prospective and active customers.

    • Support and mentor junior sales managers or regional account executives as needed.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5-10 years of experience in the solar industry, with at least 3 years of B2B sales, particularly selling to IPPs, EPCs, industry OEMs, and O&M providers.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field.

  • Skills & Competencies:

    • Strong negotiation and contract management skills.

    • Technical knowledge of utility-scale solar operations, including performance challenges within the DC field.

    • Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-level relationship skills.

    • Preferred; experience with thermal and computer vision inspection systems.

    • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM tools.

  • Travel: Up to 50%, as required to support customer meetings, industry events, and company meetings.

Nextpower offers a comprehensive benefits package. We provide health care coverage, dental and vision, 401(K) participation including company matching, company paid holidays with unlimited paid time off, generous discretionary company bonuses, life and disability protection and more. Employees in certain positions may be eligible for stock compensation. All plans are in accordance with relevant plan documents. For more information on Nextpower’s benefits please view our company website at www.Nextpower.com

Pay is based on market location and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education and other job-related reasons. The annual salary range for this position is 140,000.00 to 150,000.00 plus a commission structure based on commission calculation, such as percentage of sales or specific metrics.

NEXRSR

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are Nextpower

This position will start as a Contract with the intention to convert to full-time employment

The Strategic Sourcing and Procurement Professional is a highly experienced Sourcing Lead in the development and execution of strategic sourcing strategies for complex goods and services. This role focuses 3rd Party Expense Management and Category Strategy for Global Technology Services (GTS) and IT Management Services.

They collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify cost-saving opportunities, manage supplier relationships, and negotiate favorable contract terms while ensuring compliance with company policies and best practices for the following categories of spend: FinOps, End User Support, Global Technology Operations such as Compute Storage and IaaS, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology (ETOC) such as Network Technologies, Digital Workplace Solutions, Endpoint Resilience, Endpoint Technology, Telecom, and Collaboration Technology.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Sourcing Planning:

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify potential suppliers and assess market trends.

  • Develop comprehensive sourcing strategies for assigned categories, including cost reduction targets, supplier selection criteria, and risk mitigation plans.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and translate the into clear sourcing requirements.

RFx Management:

  • Lead the design and execution of Request for Information (RFI), Request for Quotation

  • (RFQ), and Request for Proposal (RFP) processes.

Proscia is revolutionizing pathology, the last major frontier in healthcare to embrace digital. As a leader in pathology AI software, we are empowering pathologists and scientists to transition from traditional microscope-based workflows to digital, AI-driven approaches, unlocking new possibilities in precision medicine.

The digital pathology market is experiencing explosive growth as advances in AI enable unprecedented insights into diseases like cancer. Pathology is central to medicine, and the shift to AI-powered solutions is not just modernizing workflows—it’s transforming how diseases are diagnosed, treated, and understood. Predictions for the future of pathology show a tidal wave of adoption, with experts describing the field as “poised for the next major breakthrough” in healthcare innovation.

Backed by over $100 million in funding from leading healthcare and technology investors, Proscia is at the forefront of this revolution. Joining Proscia means being part of a company at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, where the possibilities are limitless. With the convergence of AI, precision medicine, and digital pathology, we’re not just changing pathology—we’re redefining what’s possible in medicine.

About the Role

As an Implementation Engineer, you’ll lead the technical delivery of Proscia’s platform to customers across on-premise, SaaS, and cloud environments—handling installation, migration, and advisory services from kickoff to go-live. You’ll work across teams (Professional Services, Sales, Product, Engineering) and directly with customers throughout EMEA. AI tools are a natural part of how you navigate unfamiliar integration landscapes, validate your work, and solve problems that don’t come with a playbook. This role is for a technologist obsessed with positive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical delivery of customer deployments—from planning through installation, integration, and validation—using AI to accelerate your work through unfamiliar territory and to catch issues before the customer does.
  • Partner with Solution Architects to translate architecture and design into validated technical configurations—prototyping and testing with AI and other tools to ensure accuracy before deployment.
  • Drive implementations to customer acceptance—owning quality, managing expectations, and ensuring the delivered solution meets the standard both you and the customer expect.
  • Configuring our customer’s technical specifications, integration requirements, and interface preferences during customer implementations.
  • Resolve technical issues during installation—you’re resourceful, whether that means deep-diving into logs, reaching for AI to accelerate your analysis, or bridging context between teams.
  • Collaborating with product and engineering teams to provide further support and advance feature requests.
  • Reviewing customer feedback, compiling and analyzing data, and recommending technical changes as appropriate.
  • Help build and maintain internal deployment standards and documentation that work for both humans and AI-augmented workflows—because the quality of what AI can do for the next deployment starts with the quality of context from the last one.

About You

You think in systems—you reason about how infrastructure, applications, and customer workflows interact.. AI tools are part of how you work every day: navigating unfamiliar integration landscapes, validating configurations, solving problems that don’t come with clear documentation. You know when to trust AI output and when it needs different guardrails. You own your deliverables and care deeply about getting things right for the customer.

Technical Requirements:

  • Experience with Linux (RHEL, CentOS, or Ubuntu) and Windows operating systems, including running scripts and commands in a shell environment.
  • Working knowledge of web-based application architecture and related networking—SSL certificates, DNS, and how they interact in customer environments.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Azure infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, and equivalents)—enough to configure and troubleshoot in customer environments.
  • Experience with storage solutions such as Azure Blob, AWS S3, NFS, etc.
  • Experience with running containerized applications using Docker or Kubernetes.

Additional Requirements:

  • At least 5+ years of experience in enterprise IT solutions.
  • A technical leader who is constantly looking for ways to improve
  • Strong communicator comfortable speaking with our customers
  • Strong business acumen with an ability to identify and articulate key value to customers
  • Comfortable presenting to a range of stakeholders from engineers and architects to IT managers and CIOs.
  • Ability to run several projects in parallel and with a passion to work in a scale-up environment
  • You already use AI tools in your technical work—for troubleshooting, navigating unfamiliar systems, validating configurations, or however it fits your practice. This isn’t a future aspiration; it’s how we expect our implementation engineers to operate.
  • Experience building with or on top of LLMs, AI agents, or agentic pipelines—or demonstrated hands-on fluency applying AI tools to real technical problems beyond basic code completion.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, tool use patterns, and evaluation of AI systems—you know when AI output is ready to use and when it needs different guardrails.
  • Fluent in English

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in healthcare, regulated industries, or mission-critical systems where failure has real consequences.
  • Background that spans multiple domains or disciplines—you’ve reinvented yourself before.
  • Open-source contributions, side projects, or a portfolio that shows how you think and build.
  • Active in technical communities, forums, or meetups—you stay close to where the field is moving.
  • Additional European languages beyond English.

Beyond Just Work

Being a Proscian means believing in a mission, overcoming challenges in the journey together, and sharing in what success brings. We believe that every major growth period creates an exceptional career runway. We’re here to change the world together and empower each other to become our best selves in the process.

As a company in the healthcare field, we want our people to be happy and healthy, in and out of the office. In addition to competitive pay, we ensure everyone on our team is supported with savings, schedule, and insurance options that promote long-term health and personal growth.

At Proscia, we value difference, celebrate growth, and support our team’s personal and professional success. Join us in changing the world and advancing humankind.

Materials Science Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.description:
das werden deine aufgaben sein:

Remote (Deutschland) | Bevorzugt im Raum Köln | 12–20 Stunden pro Woche | Start: nach Absprache


Du möchtest den Social-Media-Auftritt von Deutschlands größter Creator-Dartsliga mitgestalten?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir sind Bright Up, eine Vermarktungsagentur für New Sports Entertainment. Wir entwickeln Sponsoring- und Markenpartnerschaften rund um Darts, Esport und Fußball und verbinden Marken mit relevanten Communities, spannenden Persönlichkeiten und innovativen Formaten.

Im Mittelpunkt steht dabei The Last Flight. Was als Creator-Dartsliga gestartet ist, entwickelt sich zu einem eigenen Darts-Entertainment-Ökosystem mit Live-Events, Community-Formaten, Creator-Content, digitalen Produkten und langfristigen Markenpartnerschaften. Unser Ziel ist es, Darts für eine neue Generation relevanter, zugänglicher und unterhaltsamer zu machen.

Darüber hinaus arbeiten wir mit Persönlichkeiten wie Martin Schindler, Adrian Geiler und Bela Darts sowie Projekten und Organisationen wie Eintracht Spandau, BIG und INSTINCT3 zusammen.
Bei uns arbeitest du nicht an theoretischen Konzepten, sondern an echten Partnerschaften mit Marken, Talents und Sportprojekten, die aktiv wachsen und entwickelt werden.

Dabei begleitest du den gesamten Prozess einer Partnerschaft: von der ersten Idee und dem Pitch über die Entwicklung eines Angebots bis hin zur Umsetzung und Betreuung unserer Partner im laufenden Projekt.

Deine Aufgaben

Gemeinsam mit unserem Team entwickelst du den Social-Media-Auftritt von The Last Flight weiter.
Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Planung und Betreuung unserer Social-Media-Kanäle (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn und weitere)
  • Erstellung von Beiträgen, Reels, Storys und Kurzvideos
  • Unterstützung bei der Content-Produktion auf unseren Events
  • Entwicklung neuer Content-Formate und kreativer Ideen
  • Erstellung von Grafiken und einfachen Social Assets
  • Umsetzung von verkauften Sponsoren-Leistungen mit Fokus auf Social Media
  • Community Management und Interaktion mit unserer Community
  • Unterstützung bei Redaktionsplanung und Content-Kalender
  • Analyse der Performance unserer Inhalte und Ableitung neuer Ideen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Creatorn, Spielern und Partnern

das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Laufendes Studium (z. B. Marketing, Medien, Kommunikation oder vergleichbar)
  • Begeisterung für Social Media und digitalen Content
  • Gespür für aktuelle Trends auf Instagram, TikTok und Co.
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva oder ähnlichen Tools sind von Vorteil
  • Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Lust, Dinge auszuprobieren
  • Begeisterung für Darts und Creator-Content – Interesse an Esport oder Fußball ist ein Plus

das kannst du von uns erwarten:

  • Verantwortung für den Social-Auftritt eines der spannendsten Darts-Projekte Deutschlands
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und dem gesamten The Last Flight Team
  • Einblicke hinter die Kulissen von Produktionen, Events und Creator-Shootings
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten von 12 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, angepasst an dein Studium.
  • Ein Remote-first-Arbeitsmodell. Gleichzeitig freuen wir uns besonders über Bewerbungen aus dem Raum Köln, damit wir uns regelmäßig persönlich austauschen und gemeinsam an Projekten arbeiten können.
  • Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Wir verstehen Werkstudent*innen nicht als kurzfristige Unterstützung. Unser Ziel ist es, Talente langfristig zu entwickeln. Bei erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit besteht ausdrücklich die Möglichkeit, nach deinem Studium Teil unseres festen Teams zu werden.
Interesse?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Worte darüber, warum du Teil von Bright Up werden möchtest.

raw.description:
About Youth Athletes United

Youth Athletes United is a dynamic and fast-growing organization dedicated to empowering young athletes through sport, teamwork, and personal development. As we continue to expand our portfolio of brands through strategic acquisitions, we are seeking a visionary marketing leader to build and scale our enterprise marketing function and drive growth across our entire brand portfolio.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Marketing will serve as the senior marketing leader for Youth Athletes United, responsible for establishing and executing the overarching marketing strategy across our growing portfolio of brands. This role is critical to building the marketing infrastructure, processes, and team needed to scale the organization as additional brands are acquired and integrated. The VP of Marketing will lead a multi-brand marketing function, connecting marketing activity directly to revenue growth while ensuring each brand maintains a strong, differentiated market position. This role reports directly to the CEO/President of Youth Athletes United.

Primary Focus

Establish the overarching marketing strategy and infrastructure needed to scale the portfolio as additional brands are acquired. The VP of Marketing will serve as the architect of enterprise-level marketing, balancing the needs of individual brands with the strategic priorities of the overall organization.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio-Level Marketing Leadership

  • Develop and execute an enterprise-wide marketing strategy that drives growth, brand equity, and customer acquisition across the entire Youth Athletes United brand portfolio
  • Establish a scalable marketing infrastructure including processes, systems, and standards that support the efficient integration of newly acquired brands
  • Serve as the primary marketing voice at the executive leadership level, connecting marketing initiatives directly to revenue outcomes, growth targets, and organizational priorities

Multi-Brand Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Lead the development of annual and long-term marketing strategies for each brand within the portfolio, ensuring alignment with overall organizational goals
  • Define and manage brand architecture and positioning across the portfolio, ensuring each brand has a clear, differentiated identity while maintaining cohesion within the Youth Athletes United family
  • Determine the appropriate balance between centralized marketing functions and brand-specific marketing efforts, optimizing for both efficiency and brand authenticity

Marketing Integration for Acquired Brands

  • Lead the marketing due diligence and integration process for newly acquired brands, developing onboarding frameworks that align new brands with Youth Athletes United standards and infrastructure
  • Assess the marketing capabilities, assets, and gaps of acquired brands and develop integration roadmaps that minimize disruption while maximizing growth opportunity
  • Establish consistent brand standards, messaging frameworks, and marketing playbooks that can be efficiently applied to new brands as they join the portfolio

Customer Acquisition & Growth Strategy

  • Develop and oversee enterprise-wide customer acquisition strategies across digital, traditional, and emerging marketing channels
  • Identify and capitalize on cross-portfolio growth opportunities including cross-brand promotions, shared audience strategies, and unified loyalty and engagement programs
  • Drive data-driven decision making by establishing customer segmentation, targeting, and personalization strategies that improve acquisition efficiency and customer lifetime value across all brands

Marketing Budgets & Resource Allocation

  • Own and manage the enterprise marketing budget, ensuring strategic allocation of resources across brands, channels, and initiatives to maximize ROI
  • Develop budget frameworks that balance investment across brand-specific needs and centralized marketing functions
  • Provide regular budget performance reporting to the executive leadership team, making data-informed recommendations for reallocation and optimization

Marketing Technology & Infrastructure

  • Evaluate, select, and oversee the implementation of marketing technology platforms including CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and content management systems across the portfolio
  • Establish a unified marketing technology stack that supports scalability, data integrity, and operational efficiency across all brands
  • Ensure all brands are leveraging technology to its fullest potential to drive personalization, automation, and measurable marketing performance

Agency & Vendor Strategy

  • Develop and manage an enterprise agency and vendor strategy, identifying opportunities to consolidate partnerships for efficiency while ensuring each brand receives the specialized support it needs
  • Negotiate and manage contracts with key agency partners, media vendors, and marketing service providers
  • Establish clear performance expectations, KPIs, and accountability frameworks for all agency and vendor relationships

Enterprise Marketing KPIs & Reporting

  • Define, track, and report on enterprise-level marketing KPIs including brand awareness, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, revenue attribution, and portfolio-wide marketing ROI
  • Develop and deliver regular marketing performance dashboards and executive reporting that clearly connect marketing activity to business outcomes
  • Establish a culture of measurement and accountability across the marketing organization, ensuring all teams are working toward clearly defined and meaningful metrics

Marketing Organization Structure & Team Development

  • Design and build a high-performing marketing organization capable of supporting a growing portfolio of brands, including defining roles, reporting structures, and future hiring priorities
  • Recruit, develop, and mentor a team of marketing professionals, fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Identify skill gaps within the current marketing team and develop hiring and development plans to address organizational needs as the portfolio scales

Marketing Processes & Standards

  • Establish standardized marketing processes, workflows, and best practices across all brands to drive consistency, efficiency, and quality of output
  • Develop a portfolio-wide marketing playbook that documents brand standards, campaign frameworks, approval processes, and go-to-market strategies
  • Implement project management and marketing operations tools that improve cross-functional collaboration and campaign execution across brands and teams

Brand Architecture & Positioning

  • Define and steward the overall brand architecture for Youth Athletes United, ensuring clarity in how the parent brand and individual portfolio brands relate to and support one another
  • Lead brand positioning and messaging development for new and existing brands, ensuring each brand occupies a clear, compelling, and defensible position in the market
  • Conduct regular brand health assessments and competitive analyses to inform positioning strategy and identify opportunities for brand differentiation and growth

Revenue & Growth Connectivity

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales, Franchise Development, Operations, and Finance to ensure marketing strategies are directly aligned with revenue and growth objectives
  • Develop marketing attribution models that provide clear visibility into how marketing investment is driving pipeline, revenue, and customer growth across the portfolio
  • Present regular marketing performance updates to executive leadership, demonstrating the direct connection between marketing activity and business results

Qualifications

Reporting Structure

This position reports directly to the CEO/President of Youth Athletes United

Youth Athletes United is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

To apply, please submit your resume, cover letter, and relevant portfolio or case studies to []

Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred, with 10+ years of progressive marketing experience including at least 5 years in a senior marketing leadership role overseeing multi-brand or multi-unit marketing strategy
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling marketing functions within a high-growth, acquisition-driven, or franchise organization with a proven track record of driving measurable customer acquisition, brand growth, and revenue impact
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills with deep expertise in digital marketing, marketing technology, brand management, and data-driven strategy

Preferred

  • Experience in the franchise, youth sports, youth education, or consumer services industry with familiarity in franchise development marketing and the franchise broker and consultant ecosystem
  • Experience leading marketing due diligence and integration for mergers and acquisitions with the ability to quickly assess brand gaps and build actionable integration roadmaps
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing significant marketing budgets, demonstrating clear ROI, and presenting performance results to executive leadership

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive executive compensation package including base salary and performance-based incentives along with a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • A mission-driven, entrepreneurial culture with significant opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly growing multi-brand organization
  • The opportunity to build and lead a marketing function from the ground up and leave a lasting impact on youth athletes and entrepreneurs nationwide
  • Health Insurance
  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Paid Time Off

raw.excerpt: Who we are:MHC is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for document, communication, and payment automation - purpose-built for highly regulated industries.
raw.description:
Who we are:

MHC is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for document, communication, and payment automation - purpose-built for highly regulated industries. We simplify complexity and unlock intelligence so organizations can deliver exceptional experiences with confidence.

Our platform helps enterprise and mid-market organizations improve efficiency, ensure compliance, and modernize customer communications at scale. Customers use MHC solutions to generate more than 10 billion documents and process billions in AP payments annually. Recognized as a Leader in multiple G2 reports and featured in analyst reports from Gartner, IDC, Aspire, and Aragon, MHC is built for organizations that can't afford to get it wrong.

People are at the center of everything we do - for our customers and within our own walls. MHC supports a flexible, work-where-you-live model, and for five consecutive years has been named one of Minnesota's Top Workplaces by the Star Tribune, based entirely on employee feedback. We are a team driven to grow, committed to being better than yesterday, and stronger together. We earn trust every day with our customers, our partners, and each other. We experiment boldly, and when our customers win, we win.

For more information, visit mhcautomation.com.

Who we are looking for:

We're looking for a hands-on Lead, Data & AI Engineering to build the data layer for MHC and the intelligence on top of it. You will own how data is ingested, modeled, governed, and served across the company, and you'll partner with Product and Engineering to ship AI- and LLM-powered features into our product.

This is a player-coach role. You will spend significant time in the code designing pipelines, building data models, and prototyping AI features while also managing and growing a small team of 1-2 data and AI engineers. You'll set the technical direction, establish the standards, and be accountable for both the platform and the people.

Why join us? MHC is at a pivotal moment. With a strong foundation and bold growth ambitions, we're not just scaling, we're transforming. We're looking for someone who isn't here to maintain the status quo, but to define what data and AI can do for our business and our customers.

This isn't a plug-and-play role. You'll have end-to-end ownership of green-field data and AI capability at a company with real data, real customers, and clear problems worth solving. You won't be handed a playbook you'll write it. You'll set the direction, build the foundation, and see your work shipped directly into the product, all while building and leading the team that does it.

If you want to architect the future of a global SaaS company, not just join it this is your opportunity.

What you will get to do:

Build the data layer

  • Architect. Design and build MHC's core data platform — ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers — across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Model. Model data for both analytics and product use cases, creating clean, well-documented, reusable datasets and a semantic layer the whole company can trust.
  • Govern. Establish data quality, lineage, observability, and governance practices so data is reliable, discoverable, and secure.
  • Pipe. Build the pipelines and feature/embedding stores that feed analytics, ML, and LLM applications.

Create intelligence from data

  • Mine. Turn raw operational and document data into intelligence — metrics, signals, predictions, and document understanding — that powers decisions and product features.
  • Apply AI. Build and evaluate models and retrieval systems (including RAG over documents) that extract, classify, summarize, and reason over MHC's data.
  • Productize. Partner with Product to design and ship LLM-powered features — from prototype to production — with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and cost controls.

Lead the team

  • Manage. Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 2–4 data and AI engineers; set goals, give feedback, and develop careers.
  • Direct. Set technical standards and a pragmatic roadmap for data and AI; make build-vs-buy decisions and balance speed with long-term maintainability.
  • Partner. Collaborate across Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to align the data and AI roadmap with company priorities.
  • Contribute. Stay hands-on — review code and designs, prototype hard problems, and set the bar for engineering quality.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • First 90 days. In 90 days: you understand MHC's data and systems, have a prioritized data & AI roadmap, and have shipped early wins to the data layer.
  • Six months. In 6 months: a reliable, documented data foundation is in place, and the first AI/LLM-powered feature is in production or in customer testing.
  • One year. In 12 months: the team is delivering a steady stream of data products and AI features, with strong quality, governance, and a growing, high-performing team.

Education and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field or equivalent years of experience.
  • 7+ years building data and/or backend systems in production, with recent hands-on experience in both data engineering and applied AI/ML.
  • Proven ownership of a data platform: strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern data tooling (e.g., a cloud warehouse/lakehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift; transformation tools like dbt; and orchestration such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect).
  • Hands-on experience building production AI/ML features, including practical work with LLMs — prompting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings/vector search, evaluation, and integrating models via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: data modeling, API design, testing, CI/CD, and building reliable systems on a major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers — whether as a manager, tech lead, or senior IC ready to step into people management — and a genuine interest in growing a team.
  • Strong product sense and communication: able to translate ambiguous business problems into data and AI solutions, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred experience, skills, and knowledge:

  • Experience with document AI / intelligent document processing (OCR, extraction, classification) or NLP over unstructured text.
  • Experience operating LLMs in production — evaluation/observability, prompt and cost optimization, fine-tuning, or agentic workflows.
  • Background in B2B SaaS, document/process automation, fintech, or other data-heavy enterprise domains.
  • Familiarity with data privacy, security, and compliance (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR) in a multi-tenant SaaS environment.
  • Experience with streaming (Kafka/Kinesis), infrastructure-as-code, and MLOps/LLMOps tooling.

Worksite Location: This is a remote role. Candidates must be based in the United States.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

MHC Comprehensive Benefits Package

We offer a robust benefits package designed to support the well-being and financial security of our employees.

Our Benefits Include:

  • Workplace Flexibility
  • 401(k) Plan: Deferred and Roth options available to help you save for retirement, with a generous employer match of 50% up to maximum of 4.5% of gross pay.
  • Medical Plans: Comprehensive co-pay or HSA coverage options to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Dental and Vision Plans: Access to a large network of providers for dental and vision health.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Idira, part of Palo Alto Networks, are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Agentic Identity Security business in the Iberia region.

The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment at scale, thrive in driving innovation, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Work with a regional sales team to establish and maintain customer relationships at the executive and business decisionmaker level including but not limited to CISO, CIO, and other executives responsible for DevOps, Secrets Management, Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance. Hold regional responsibility for meeting and exceeding established sales quota associated with Idira’s Secrets Management and Agentic Identity solutions.
  • Develop & present compelling business cases to customers, maintain expert-level knowledge of all elements of the business case, including the drivers of cost, benefits, and risk.
  • Partner closely with subject matter experts, solutions engineers, and professional services teams to align the technology architecture to the customer's desired business outcomes.
  • Work closely with post sales teams to ensure successful product adoption and realisation of the full value of customer’s technology investment.
  • Work with channel partners, resellers and systems integrators to penetrate new accounts and extend reach of Idira’s Secrets Management and Agentic Identity solutions in the assigned geography.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise level accounts. Experience as an overlay sales specialist is a bonus.

An emphasis on vendors and technologies in use across large enterprises for both on-premises and cloud is preferred.
  • Established trusted relationships with, and experience presenting to, CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations.

raw.title: Klinisch Psycholoog GGz Online
raw.excerpt: Zo werk jijAls klinisch psycholoog bij GGz Online zet je jouw expertise in binnen een volledig digitale poli.
raw.description:
Zo werk jij

Als klinisch psycholoog bij GGz Online zet je jouw expertise in binnen een volledig digitale poli. Jij:

  • verricht specialistische diagnostiek en indicatiestelling in kortdurende behandeltrajecten (gemiddeld drie maanden);

  • behandelt binnen CGT, EMDR of andere evidence-based kaders;

  • geeft supervisie aan psychologen (in opleiding) en draagt bij aan opleidingskwaliteit;

  • levert inhoudelijke en methodische bijdragen aan digitale zorgontwikkeling;

  • combineert vakinhoudelijke verdieping met innovatie in online behandelplatforms.

GGz Online is méér dan een poli op afstand. Het is een innovatieve werkomgeving waar je cliënten behandelt in hun eigen vertrouwde omgeving via veilige digitale platforms, zoals Moovd. Je maakt deel uit van een klein en hecht multidisciplinair team met korte lijnen en krijgt veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de digitale GGZ. Daarbij kun je rekenen op professionele vrijheid, mét de steun van het brede netwerk van GGz Centraal.

Jouw team

Jouw nieuwe collega’s van GGz Online kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten. Samen bieden jullie hoogwaardige specialistische zorg op afstand, met kwaliteit, eigenaarschap en innovatie als kernwaarden. Je werkplek? Volledig online, professioneel ingericht vanuit je eigen omgeving mét de verbinding en samenwerking van een team dat elkaar dagelijks digitaal ontmoet.

Wij zorgen voor jou

Werk dat er toe doet en waar je van betekenis bent, dat is alvast onze eerste belofte. We zien wie je bent en wat je kan. Als Klinisch psycholoogbij GGz Centraal kun je in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 7.002,-en € 9.725,- (CAO GGZ, functiegroep 75) o.b.v. 36 uur. Bereken hier jouw netto salaris.

  • een contract voor 24- 36uur per week voor onbepaalde tijd. We werken vanuit vertrouwen, dus je krijgt bij ons meteen een vast contract.

  • een vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • 166 verlofuren en 35 levensfase-uren o.b.v. 36 uur. Zo willen we bijdragen aan een goede werk-privébalans.

  • een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1.000,- naar rato. Dit budget kun je besteden aan iets waar jij blij van wordt. Denk aan een cursus, extra salaris of verlofuren, aan jou de keuze.

  • een persoonlijk studiebudget van € 1.800,- per jaar dat je o.a. kunt gebruiken voor registratie en herregistratie. Bij een dienstverband van minder dan 24 uur per week en/of nog geen volledig jaar in dienst, is dit bedrag naar rato.

Boven alles bieden we je een uitdagende en afwisselende baan met de ruimte om jezelf professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, trainingen en interne scholing.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO GGZ. Heb je vragen? Laat het ons weten.

Requirements

Dit breng je mee

Als klinisch psycholoog werk je zorgvuldig, doordacht en met oog voor kwaliteit. Je hebt een coachende stijl in supervisie en voelt je prettig in een digitale behandelomgeving. Daarnaast:

  • heb je een afgeronde opleiding tot klinisch psycholoog met geldige BIG-registratie.

  • beschik je over ruime ervaring met CGT en bij voorkeur ook EMDR.

  • begeleid je graag collega’s en psychologen in opleiding.

  • ben je thuis in online behandelplatforms of bereid je je hierin te verdiepen.

  • zorg je voor een rustige en veilige werkplek vanuit huis, waar je cliënten professioneel kunt ontvangen via beeldbellen.

Wie zijn wij?

GGz Online is de digitale poli van GGz Centraal. Wij bieden specialistische geestelijke gezondheidszorg volledig online, met als doel cliënten snel en effectief te ondersteunen in hun herstel. Onze behandelingen zijn kortdurend (3-4 maanden), hoog intensief en gebaseerd op evidence-based methodieken, ondersteund door een veilige en professionele digitale omgeving. Supervisie geven en krijgen is een belangrijke kwaliteitscriterium bij ons. Tevens kennen we een ruim opleidingsbeleid passend binnen de visie en de van onze afdeling.

Binnen GGz Online staat de manier waarop jij werkt centraal: met veel autonomie, focus en ruimte voor inhoudelijke verdieping. We combineren zelfstandig werken met sterke inhoudelijke samenwerking, zodat je altijd kunt sparren met collega’s wanneer dat nodig is.

Elk jaar rekenen zo’n 25.000 patiënten op GGz Centraal als de specialist in geestelijke gezondheidszorg in midden Nederland op GGZ Centraal. GGZ Online behandelt tevens op landelijk niveau. Vanuit verschillende locaties, binnen de thuissetting én online, bieden we specialistische hulp aan mensen met psychische problemen, in alle fasen van hun leven.

Solliciteren

Wil je meer inhoudelijke informatie over de vacature? Bel of app dan met Carlos Croes, Klinisch psycholoog en hoofd behandelzaken, via 06 53 47 94 68.. Voor overige vragen helpt de recruiter je graag verder op weg.

Kom je graag eerst sfeer proeven? Een dagdeel meelopen is mogelijk als onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.  

Als we dé geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden, sluiten we de vacature eerder. Hebben we onze match nog niet gevonden? Dan zoeken we nog wat langer door.

Kom je bij ons werken, dan checken we standaard referenties en vragen we je om een actuele Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Natuurlijk vergoeden wij deze kosten.

Highlights

Zet jouw expertise in voor specialistische diagnostiek, complexe behandelingen, supervisie en de verdere ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige online specialistische ggz.

raw.title: Website AEO Manager
raw.excerpt: About the Role Buyer behavior is shifting.  Compliance leaders increasingly research vendors through AI answer engines - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot not just a page of blue links.
raw.description:
About the Role
Buyer behavior is shifting. Compliance leaders increasingly research vendors through AI answer engines - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot not just a page of blue links. At the same time, our website is where interest becomes pipeline. This role brings both under one owner: a high-performing website that converts, and a deliberate strategy to be discovered, understood and cited by the engines our buyers now trust. You’ll be the person who turns “AEO” from a buzzword into a measurable, company-wide capability at MCO.

Responsibilities
Website & conversion
  • Own the strategy, roadmap and day-to-day performance of mycomplianceoffice.com, with conversion as the primary success metric.
  • Drive conversion rate optimization (CRO): hypothesis-led A/B and multivariate testing, funnel analysis, form and CTA optimization, and continuous improvement of high-intent paths (demo requests, content downloads, contact).
  • Design and optimize landing pages and conversion journeys in partnership with demand generation, so every campaign lands somewhere built to convert.
  • Manage site performance and UX fundamentals - Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile experience, accessibility, information architecture.
  • Own the analytics picture: GA4, heatmaps/session tools, HubSpot reporting; translate data into a prioritized backlog of experiments and fixes.
  • Manage the CMS (HubSpot CMS) and coordinate any external developers, designers or agencies.

AEO leadership
Be the in-house expert
  • Serve as MCO’s authority on Answer Engine Optimization how AI answer engines discover, interpret, trust and cite sources and stay ahead of a fast-moving discipline.
  • Make our content citable and machine-readable: clear, factual, well-structured answers; structured data / schema markup; entity and topical authority; FAQ and comparison formats; technical signals for AI crawlers (e.g., robots directives, llms.txt, crawlability).
  • Strengthen off-site presence that AI engines pull from review platforms (e.g., G2), authoritative third-party sources, and digital PR so MCO shows up credibly beyond our own domain.
Be the evangelist
  • Build internal awareness and buy-in for AEO across marketing, product marketing, content, sales and leadership.
  • Translate AEO from abstract concept into concrete, “here’s why it matters to your work” terms for each audience.
Educate the company
  • Create and run enablement guidelines, playbooks, lunch-and-learns that teach teams what AEO is and the specific things they can do to help (how to write citable content, when to add structured data, how product and sales language shapes what engines surface).
Prioritize the roadmap
  • Own and sequence the AEO backlog: identify the high-intent compliance questions our buyers ask engines, find where MCO is (and isn’t) being surfaced, and prioritize the content, technical and off-site work that moves the narrative fastest.
  • Partner with content and product marketing to shape assets specifically designed to be discovered and cited.
Measure and monitor
  • Stand up AEO measurement from scratch: track MCO’s visibility, mentions, citations and share of voice in AI answers across the key engines; monitor AI-driven referral traffic; benchmark against competitors.
  • Report on AEO performance to marketing leadership and connect it, where possible, to pipeline influence.

Experience and Skills
  • 5+ years in digital marketing, web/SEO, or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated conversion/CRO results you’ve run experiments that measurably improved website performance, not just managed a site.
  • Strong SEO foundation that you’re actively evolving toward AEO / generative search, with a real point of view on how AI is changing discovery.
  • Fluency with web analytics and experimentation tools (GA4, heatmaps, A/B testing) and comfort turning data into prioritized action.
  • Hands-on CMS experience and a working understanding of structured data/schema and technical on-page fundamentals.
  • Excellent communicator who can teach a non-technical audience and rally cross-functional teams around a new idea.

Nice to Have
  • Experience marketing to financial services, compliance, risk or other regulated, considered-purchase buyers.
  • HubSpot (CMS and Marketing Hub) experience.
  • Early, hands-on experience with AEO/GEO tooling and AI-answer monitoring.
  • Comfort working with developers and briefing/managing agencies.

About MCO (MyComplianceOffice)
MCO is a global leader dedicated to empowering Financial Services firms to manage compliance programs with ease and efficiency. Our mission is to foster a fair, transparent, and trusted financial environment worldwide by helping organizations meet their regulatory obligations to society.

At the heart of MCO’s offering is our unique, unified platform, which seamlessly integrates compliance monitoring and data into a single, comprehensive view. This holistic approach enables firms to maintain compliance across all internal systems, structures, and processes—ensuring peace of mind in an ever-evolving regulatory landscape.

Headquartered in Dublin, MCO has an international footprint, with offices in London, Singapore, Hyderabad, New York, Chicago, Fort Worth, Switzerland, South Africa, Slovenia, and the UAE. Since our founding in 2008, we have evolved from a specialist provider of “best of breed” employee compliance solutions to a pioneer in integrated compliance technology.

Today, our team of over 400 professionals supports more than 1.5 million users in 128 countries. Our diverse customer base includes small businesses, large enterprises, four of the world’s top ten asset managers, twenty of the top seventy-five global banks, and three of the top five investment banks for global M&A transactions.
